items.detail: Synthesizing unstructured research materials into manuscripts is an essential yet under-explored challenge in AI-driven scientific discovery. Existing autonomous writers are rigidly coupled to specific experimental pipelines, and produce superficial literature reviews. We introduce PaperOrchestra, a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams. To evaluate performance, we present PaperWritingBench, the first standardized benchmark of reverse-engineered raw materials from 200 top-tier AI conference papers, alongside a comprehensive suite of automated evaluators. In side-by-side human evaluations, PaperOrchestra significantly outperforms autonomous baselines, achieving an absolute win rate margin of 50%-68% in literature review quality, and 14%-38% in overall manuscript quality.
items.title_zh: 纸管会：自动AI研究文件编写多代理框架
items.detail_zh: 将非结构化的研究材料合成为手稿，是AI驱动的科学发现中一项基本而探索不足的挑战。现有自主写作人员与具体的实验管线紧密结合，产生肤浅的文学评论。我们介绍Paper Orchestra，一个自动AI研究纸写作的多代理框架。它能灵活地将不受约束的预写材料转换为可提交准备的LaTeX手稿，包括全面的文献合成和生成视觉，如地图和概念图。为了评价业绩，我们提出了PaperWriting Bench，这是200份顶级AI会议文件中第一个反向工程原材料标准化基准，以及一套全面的自动评价员。在相邻的人类评价中，Paper Orchestra显著地超越了自主基线，在文献审查质量中实现了50%至68%的绝对取胜率，在整体手稿质量中达到了14%至38%。

items.detail: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR.
items.title_zh: 无限制 OCR 工程
items.detail_zh: 最近，端到端的OCR模型，以Deep Seek OCR为例，再次将OCR推向了聚光灯。广泛持有的观点是，使用大语言模型(LLM)作为解码器可以让模型利用语言的事先分布，导致OCR性能的提高。然而，下行同样明显：随着输出序列的延长，累积的KV缓存驱动内存消耗，并逐渐减慢生成速度。这与人类形成了鲜明的对照，在长距离复制任务中，人类的效率并没有下降。在这份技术报告中，我们提出无限OCR，这个模型旨在模仿人类解析工作记忆。将DeepSeek OCR作为基线，我们用我们提议的参考滑动窗口注意(R-SWA)来取代解码器中的所有注意层，这降低了注意计算成本，同时在整个解码过程中保持一个恒定的KV缓存。通过将DeepSeek OCR编码器的高压缩速率与我们恒定的KV缓存设计相结合，无限制的OCR可以在标准最高长度为32K的单个前传中将数十页文件转录。更重要的是，R-SWA是一种通用的解析注意力机制——除了OCR之外，它同样适用于ASR，翻译等任务。代码和模型权重在http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR上公开。

items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.subtitle: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier
items.detail: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
items.title_zh: 深度 Pro 2：尖锐和短暂一致的度量衡单体深度
items.detail_zh: 我们提出深度方案2，这是对图像和视频的密集度进行全分辨率估计的方法。通过分析先前的单倍深度估计方法，我们发现它们通常与时间一致性和边界锐度进行交换：多帧法有利于一致性，单帧法有利于锐度。为了克服这种权衡，我们训练一个单一的，可伸缩的网络，处理图像和视频，并以原生分辨率预测深度地图。深度 Pro 2 绘制出精确度、锐度和时间一致的深度图，一次一次比所有这些方面先前的工作表现好。我们发布了一组模型，这些模型定义了一个新的帕雷托边疆，在度量精确度，锐度，时间一致性和运行时间等方面。我们在https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-septh-pro-2/上发布代码和权重。

items.detail: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
items.title_zh: Gamer：一个通用视觉-语言-行动基金会模式 长视实时游戏代理商
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍Gamer，一个为复杂互动环境中的长视距任务而构建的通用代理框架。其端对端架构结合了感知，内存管理和多步推理。共享培训和部署管道支持与传统2D图形界面和复杂的3D模拟世界的互动。我们首先继续通过数以万计小时的设备级键盘和鼠标交互构建的数据集进行预训。这些轨迹跨越模拟游戏和包含的环境，使模型能够学习物理和虚拟领域的环境动态。然后，Sparse-thinking disculation 调制会大大减少冗余计算，同时保留复杂决策所需的推理。我们用一种稳定的多回合强化学习方法来训练长期互动政策，解决有限的上下文窗口、累积的推出错误和微薄的回报。对于实时互动，一个云端推论引擎同时为众多模拟游戏环境服务，支持无约束的折叠文字执行，并保持在线推论延迟度低。在整个多款挑战性的3D开放世界游戏中，Gamer展现出与熟练玩家相当的固态概括和操作效率。它还在一系列常规2D游戏基准上取得竞争结果。这些结果表明，即使是重复的键盘和鼠标轨迹也可以支持从缩放数据和学习算法中获得巨大的收益。关于这些轨迹的培训帮助Gamer在具有物理和数字特性的环境下更稳定地学习复杂的技能。这种方法为通俗主义代理人提供了一条可以跨越数字和物理世界互动的道路。

items.detail: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
items.title_zh: TokenEconomizer：经验驱动的编码代理黑盒成本控制
items.detail_zh: 前沿编码代理商的进步使AI辅助软件工程的象征性成本急剧增加。他们的象征效率通常在孤立的任务上得到评价，而现实世界的开发者则利用它们来持续地构建，更新和维护大型项目。这种不匹配促使我们评价代理商超越现实的编码任务的序列，我们发现代理商表现出经常性的以环境为依存的象征性成本，而现有方法难以减少这些成本。为了尽量减少这些成本，我们引入了TokenEconomizer，一个外部控制器，通过一系列任务削减特定环境的象征性成本。这些削减来自于确定：(一) 注入哪些操作性微型技能，(二) 哪些工具一直无关紧要，以及(三) 何时干预非生产性故障循环。在Claude Code， Codex，和 GitHub 副驾驶CLI 与前沿模型对齐， TokenEconomizer 将平均代币成本降低了18.4%-30.9%，并取得了相似的任务成功。在每个经测试的代理模式设置下，每个存储库都有节余，并被概括到不同领域，如连续的网络开发和安全审计，根据任务结构，成本下降6.4至21.2%。我们的工作建立了适应性的黑盒成本控制，作为在现实环境中降低编码剂象征性成本的有希望的方向。

items.detail: Significant progress has been made in automated problem-solving using societies of agents powered by large language models (LLMs). In finance, efforts have largely focused on single-agent systems handling specific tasks or multi-agent frameworks independently gathering data. However, the multi-agent systems' potential to replicate real-world trading firms' collaborative dynamics remains underexplored. TradingAgents proposes a novel stock trading framework inspired by trading firms, featuring LLM-powered agents in specialized roles such as fundamental analysts, sentiment analysts, technical analysts, and traders with varied risk profiles. The framework includes Bull and Bear researcher agents assessing market conditions, a risk management team monitoring exposure, and traders synthesizing insights from debates and historical data to make informed decisions. By simulating a dynamic, collaborative trading environment, this framework aims to improve trading performance. Detailed architecture and extensive experiments reveal its superiority over baseline models, with notable improvements in cumulative returns, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown, highlighting the potential of multi-agent LLM frameworks in financial trading. TradingAgents is available at https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents.
items.title_zh: TradingAgents：基于多智能体大语言模型的金融交易框架
items.detail_zh: 在利用由大语言模型提供动力的代理人组成的社会自动解决问题方面取得了重大进展。在财务方面，工作主要集中于处理具体任务的单一代理系统或独立收集数据的多代理框架。然而，多种代理系统复制现实世界贸易公司合作动力的潜力仍然没有得到充分利用。贸易代理公司提出了一个新的股票交易框架，其灵感来自贸易公司，其特点是由LLM驱动的代理公司具有基本分析师、情绪分析师、技术分析师和具有不同风险特征的贸易商等专门作用。该框架包括公牛和熊的研究人员评估市场状况、风险管理小组监测风险，以及贸易商从辩论和历史数据中综合见解，以作出知情决定。这个框架通过模拟一个充满活力、协作的贸易环境，旨在改善贸易业绩。详细的架构和广泛的实验表明其优于基线模型，在累积收益、夏普比率和最大缩减方面有显著改善，突出了多种代理人LLM框架在金融交易中的潜力。贸易代理商可在https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents查询。
items.subtitle_zh: 虽然大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统已经能够协作解决复杂问题，金融领域的既有研究仍主要依赖单一 Agent，或者让多个 Agent 独立收集信息，尚未充分模拟真实交易公司的协作机制。TradingAgents 借鉴交易机构的组织方式，为基本面、市场情绪、技术分析和不同风险偏好的交易设置专门角色，并加入多空研究员辩论与风险管理团队，最终由交易 Agent 综合辩论与历史数据形成决策。

items.detail: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.
items.title_zh: Harness^2：面向开放世界的递归式 Agent Harness 优化
items.detail_zh: LLM代理的能力不仅取决于其基本模式，还取决于其执行手段。递归自我改进(RSI)为自动发展这些绳索提供了一个很有希望的方法。然而，在开放世界环境中部署区域安全倡议仍然面临两个重大挑战。首先，开放世界的任务通常在利用设计阶段和试验时不为人知，没有地面实况核查员可靠地指导在线利用编辑。第二， " 区域倡议 " 进程仍然高度具体的任务，未能概括为新情况。我们引入了Harness ^2，一个插座与游戏，递归剂的利用框架，通过两个相互关联的递归层次来应对这些挑战。任务层面的重复利用对比性的提议-预测步骤改进了当前任务的利用，该步骤可靠地指导没有地面真实核查员的编辑工作，并通过平行或相继的重复可以进一步缩小。然后利用这些编辑的经验来更新不断改进的利用率，使代理人能够更好地适应未来的任务。通过三个专业基准和四个模型harness配置，一个步骤持续改进了GLM-5和双子座3.5 闪烁他们的底盘，在WorkBuddy-Bench上收获高达11.5分，在JobBench上收获4.5分，在LAB上收获11.8个百分点，随着任务层次的递归预算的增加，进一步收益。
items.subtitle_zh: LLM Agent 的能力不仅取决于底层模型，也取决于执行它的 Harness。递归自我改进（RSI）有望自动优化这些执行框架，但开放世界任务带来两个关键难题：一是测试时遇到的新任务通常没有标准答案验证器，难以可靠指导在线修改；二是现有 RSI 方法高度依赖具体任务，难以迁移到新场景。Harness^2 提出一套即插即用的双层递归框架：任务层通过对比式“提出—探测—组合”过程改进当前 Harness，并支持并行或串行扩展；更高层则尝试积累可迁移的优化经验。

items.title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
items.subtitle: π^4 is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. items.detail: π^4 is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, π^4 achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.
items.title_zh: QQ4：四维场景几何和运动的基础模型
items.detail_zh: XQ4是4D场景感知的统一基础模型。从野生-a单像中多样，未校准的RGB观测，无序采集，或视频序列-它恢复了密集的几何，相机姿势，和度量尺度，同时还有2D/3D点轨和移动对象口罩用于多图像输入。它将一个几何分支与一个几何条件的运动分支相配，它通过重建的目标-视野几何来预测被提升为3D的图像-空间对应。在各种基准中，QQ4在几何评价中实现了最佳的总体平均排名，同时在单视和多视2D/3D点跟踪和移动对象分化中实现了竞争业绩。有了共享的骨干，完整的几何和运动系统包含大约0.5B参数——小于大多数基线大小的一半。它以一个前进通道制作联合的重建和轨道，包括大规模场景，尽管培训了最多64个观点的背景，但有数千个输入图像。我们进一步介绍了这些能力所依据的数据和培训方法，以及对关键设计选择的经验研究。代码和模型见https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4。

items.detail: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs), led by BitNet b1.58, has spurred interest in ternary LLMs. Despite this, research and practical applications focusing on efficient edge inference for ternary LLMs remain scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce Bitnet.cpp, an inference system optimized for BitNet b1.58 and ternary LLMs. Given that mixed-precision matrix multiplication (mpGEMM) constitutes the bulk of inference time in ternary LLMs, Bitnet.cpp incorporates a novel mpGEMM library to facilitate sub-2-bits-per-weight, efficient and lossless inference. The library features two core solutions: Ternary Lookup Table (TL), which addresses spatial inefficiencies of previous bit-wise methods, and Int2 with a Scale (I2_S), which ensures lossless edge inference, both enabling high-speed inference. Our experiments show that Bitnet.cpp achieves up to a 6.25x increase in speed over full-precision baselines and up to 2.32x over low-bit baselines, setting new benchmarks in the field. Additionally, we expand TL to element-wise lookup table (ELUT) for low-bit LLMs in the appendix, presenting both theoretical and empirical evidence of its considerable potential. Bitnet.cpp is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper , offering a sophisticated solution for the efficient and practical deployment of edge LLMs.
items.title_zh: Bitnet.cpp：特尔纳里LLMs的高效边缘推论
items.detail_zh: 由 BitNet b1.58 牵头的1位大语言模型(LLM)的出现，激发了对ternary LLMs的兴趣。尽管如此，侧重于三边法学硕士的有效边缘推论的研究和实际应用仍然很少。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Bitnet.cpp，一个为BitNet b1.58和ternary LLMs优化的推论系统。鉴于混合精度矩阵乘法(mpGEMM)构成Ternary LLMs的大部分推论时间， Bitnet.cpp 包含了一款新的 mpGEMM 库来方便子-2位/人/人/人/人/人的推论。该库有两个核心解决方案：Trinary Lookup Table(TL)，它解决了以前位取方法的空间效率低下问题；和I2 S的Int2，它确保了无损失的边缘推论，两者都有利于高速推论。我们的实验显示，Bitnet.cpp比全精度基线达到6.25x增速，比低位基线达到2.32x增速，为球场设定了新的基准。此外，我们还将TL扩展为附录中低位 LLMs 的元素取向表(ELUT)，提出了其巨大潜力的理论和经验证据。 Bitnet.cpp可在https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper上公开查阅，为有效实际部署边缘有限责任公司提供了一个复杂的解决方案。

items.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

items.detail: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4times with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
items.title_zh: 高效的大型语言模型内存管理
items.detail_zh: 服务于大型语言模型的高吞吐量需要一次批量处理足够多的请求。然而，由于每个请求的密钥-值缓存(KV缓存)内存巨大，并不断增长和动态收缩，所以现有系统挣扎。在管理效率低下的情况下，这种内存可能会被破碎和冗余的重复大量浪费，限制了批量大小。为了解决这个问题，我们提出PagedAttenty，一种受经典虚拟内存和操作系统中的呼唤技术启发的注意力算法。在它之上，我们建造了vLLM，一个LLM服务系统，实现(1) KV缓存内存中的近零浪费，以及(2) KV缓存在请求内部和相互之间灵活共享，以进一步减少内存使用。我们的评价表明，VLLM比最新系统，如S更快的Transformer和Orca，在耐久性上提高了2-4次流行LLM的吞吐量。改进更为显著的是较长的序列，更大的模型，更复杂的解码算法。 vLLM的源代码在https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm上公开发布。

items.detail: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0 serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.
items.title_zh: 记忆墙的另一半：使用训练列车预告服务SSD的35B MoEs
items.detail_zh: 对消费硬件的Mixture-of-experiments(MoE)推论以重量内存为界：一个35B级模型在4位时为19.5GB，而sparsity缩小了每个符的计算，而不是必须持有的字节。将直觉卸载到SSD本身无济于事，因为N+1层的专家必须在N层输出存在之前被选中，因此读数不能提前开始到隐藏在计算后。我们提出Edge0，一种用前导线关闭缺口的流动的MOE推论引擎：每层头部预测下一层的路由前方的1个符号，而预测作为路由本身消耗，所以舞台专家集等于路由集，一无所获。一次未合并的恢复LORA，在学生路径上接受培训，将损失的质量还给Int4量化和路由替换。在一台24GB单机上，Edge0在峰值活动内存的3GiB内部以20tok/s的速度为35B MoE服务，平均在fp16老师的几点范围内服务于5个公共基准。 8B级在同一框架上运行，框架、检查站和适配器是开放源码。

items.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution

Rather than committing to a fixed offloading strategy, FreeToken continuously maps computation and model state onto the resources actually available. FreeToken supports more than 20 MoE models and real coding and tool-using agents across hardware ranging from an 8GB laptop GPU to a single workstation GPU. More importantly, it changes what these machines can practically serve, from a 35B model on a laptop to a 284B model on a gaming desktop and the 753B GLM-5.2 on a single workstation GPU. FreeToken turns open weights into deployable local software, making the machines users already own a practical platform for frontier-scale intelligence. We release the system at flashml.ai.

items.detail: Software is one of the most powerful tools that we humans have at our disposal; it allows a skilled programmer to interact with the world in complex and profound ways. At the same time, thanks to improvements in large language models (LLMs), there has also been a rapid development in AI agents that interact with and affect change in their surrounding environments. In this paper, we introduce OpenDevin, a platform for the development of powerful and flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a human developer: by writing code, interacting with a command line, and browsing the web. We describe how the platform allows for the implementation of new agents, safe interaction with sandboxed environments for code execution, coordination between multiple agents, and incorporation of evaluation benchmarks. Based on our currently incorporated benchmarks, we perform an evaluation of agents over 15 challenging tasks, including software engineering (e.g., SWE-Bench) and web browsing (e.g., WebArena), among others. Released under the permissive MIT license, OpenDevin is a community project spanning academia and industry with more than 1.3K contributions from over 160 contributors and will improve going forward.

items.detail: Deploying large language models (LLMs) often faces challenges from substantial memory and computational costs. Quantization offers a solution, yet performance degradation in the sub-1-bit regime remains particularly difficult. This paper introduces LittleBit, a novel method for extreme LLM compression. It targets levels like 0.1 bits per weight (BPW), achieving nearly 31times memory reduction, e.g., Llama2-13B to under 0.9 GB. LittleBit represents weights in a low-rank form using latent matrix factorization, subsequently binarizing these factors. To counteract information loss from this extreme precision, it integrates a multi-scale compensation mechanism. This includes row, column, and an additional latent dimension that learns per-rank importance. Two key contributions enable effective training: Dual Sign-Value-Independent Decomposition (Dual-SVID) for stable quantization-aware training (QAT) initialization, and integrated Residual Compensation to mitigate errors. Extensive experiments confirm LittleBit's superiority in sub-1-bit quantization: e.g., its 0.1 BPW performance on Llama2-7B surpasses the leading method's 0.7 BPW. This establishes a superior size-performance trade-off, with kernel-level benchmarks indicating potential for a 5times speedup compared to FP16. LittleBit paves the way for deploying powerful LLMs in resource-constrained environments.
items.title_zh: 小Bit：通过Latent因子化进行超低Bit量化
items.detail_zh: 部署大型语文模型往往面临大量内存和计算费用的挑战。量化提供了一个解决方案，但子-1位制度中的性能退化仍然特别困难。本文引入了LittleBit，一种用于极端LLM压缩的新型方法。它的目标水平如每重量0.1比特(BPW)，实现近31次内存的减少，如Llama2-13B到0.9GB以下。小点 位值代表了使用潜在矩阵因子化的低级形态的权重，随后将这些因素二进制。为了抵消这种极端精确的信息损失，它整合了一个多尺度的补偿机制。这包括行、列和另一个潜在维度，这些维度可以了解每个等级的重要性。两项关键贡献使有效培训成为可能：用于稳定量化-意识培训(QAT)初始化的双重信号-Value-独立分解(Dual-SVID)，以及用于减轻错误的综合残余补偿。广泛的实验证实了LittleBit在子-1位量化中的优越性：例如，它在Llama2-7B上的0.1BPW性能超过了领先方法的0.7BPW。这确立了优异的大小性能权衡，与FP16相比，内核级基准显示5次提速的可能性。 LittleBit为在资源紧张的环境中部署强大的有限责任公司铺平了道路。

items.detail: Driven by rapid advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), agents are empowered to combine intrinsic knowledge with dynamic tool use, greatly enhancing their capacity to address real-world tasks. In line with such an evolution, AgentScope introduces major improvements in a new version (1.0), towards comprehensively supporting flexible and efficient tool-based agent-environment interactions for building agentic applications. Specifically, we abstract foundational components essential for agentic applications and provide unified interfaces and extensible modules, enabling developers to easily leverage the latest progress, such as new models and MCPs. Furthermore, we ground agent behaviors in the ReAct paradigm and offer advanced agent-level infrastructure based on a systematic asynchronous design, which enriches both human-agent and agent-agent interaction patterns while improving execution efficiency. Building on this foundation, we integrate several built-in agents tailored to specific practical scenarios. AgentScope also includes robust engineering support for developer-friendly experiences. We provide a scalable evaluation module with a visual studio interface, making the development of long-trajectory agentic applications more manageable and easier to trace. In addition, AgentScope offers a runtime sandbox to ensure safe agent execution and facilitates rapid deployment in production environments. With these enhancements, AgentScope provides a practical foundation for building scalable, adaptive, and effective agentic applications.
items.title_zh: AgentScope 1.0：构建代理应用程序的开发者-子框架
items.detail_zh: 在大语言模型(LLMS)快速进步的推动下，代理人被赋予将内在知识与动态工具使用相结合的能力，极大地增强了他们处理现实世界任务的能力。根据这种演变，AgentScope在新版本(1.0)中引入了重大改进，全面支持基于工具的Agent-Environment互动，以构建Agent应用。具体而言，我们抽象出对代理应用程序至关重要的基础组件，并提供统一的接口和可扩展模块，使开发人员能够轻松地利用最新进展，如新模型和MCP。此外，我们在ReAct范式中的地面代理人行为，并提供基于系统同步设计的高级代理人一级基础设施，这丰富了人与代理人和代理人之间的互动模式，同时提高了执行效率。在这个基础上，我们综合了几个适合具体实际情况的内在代理人。 AgentScope还包括对开发者友好体验的强大工程支持。我们提供了一个带有视觉工作室界面的可伸缩评价模块，使长射剂应用的开发更便于管理，更容易追踪。此外，AgentScope还提供运行时间沙盒，以确保安全剂执行，并促进在生产环境中的快速部署。借助这些增强，AgentScope为构建可伸缩性，适应性，有效的代理应用提供了实用的基础。

items.detail: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for applying multi-agent systems in very large-scale simulations. However, there remain several challenges when conducting multi-agent simulations with existing platforms, such as limited scalability and low efficiency, unsatisfied agent diversity, and effort-intensive management processes. To address these challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. Specifically, we propose an actor-based distributed mechanism as the underlying technological infrastructure towards great scalability and high efficiency, and provide flexible environment support for simulating various real-world scenarios, which enables parallel execution of multiple agents, centralized workflow orchestration, and both inter-agent and agent-environment interactions among agents. Moreover, we integrate an easy-to-use configurable tool and an automatic background generation pipeline in AgentScope, simplifying the process of creating agents with diverse yet detailed background settings. Last but not least, we provide a web-based interface for conveniently monitoring and managing a large number of agents that might deploy across multiple devices. We conduct a comprehensive simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed enhancements in AgentScope, and provide detailed observations and discussions to highlight the great potential of applying multi-agent systems in large-scale simulations. The source code is released on GitHub at https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope to inspire further research and development in large-scale multi-agent simulations.
items.title_zh: 特工中非常大的多代理模拟
items.detail_zh: 近期大语言模型(LLMs)的进步为在非常大规模的模拟中应用多剂系统开辟了新的途径。然而，在与现有平台进行多剂模拟时，仍面临若干挑战，例如可扩展性有限、效率低、代理多样性不尽人意、以及工作密集型管理程序。为了应对这些挑战，我们为AgentScope开发了几个新的功能和组件，AgentScope是一个方便用户的多代理平台，增强了它支持非常大规模多代理模拟的方便性和灵活性。具体地说，我们提议建立一个基于行为者的分布式机制，作为实现巨大可扩展性和高效益的基础技术基础设施，并为模拟各种现实世界情景提供灵活的环境支持，从而能够同时执行多种代理人、集中工作流程协调以及代理人之间和代理人与环境之间的互动。此外，我们在AgentScope中整合了一个易于配置的工具和自动背景生成管道，简化了创建具有多样但详细背景环境的代理的程序。最后但并非最不重要的是，我们提供了一个基于网络的界面，以方便地监测和管理可能跨多个设备部署的大量代理人。我们进行了全面的模拟，以展示AgentScope中拟议的增强措施的有效性，并提供详细的观察和讨论，以强调在大规模模拟中应用多剂系统的巨大潜力。源代码发布于GitHub上的https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope，以激励在大规模多剂模拟中的进一步研发。

items.detail: We introduce MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy while maintaining exceptional computational efficiency. Our approach employs a coarse-to-fine, two-stage parsing strategy that decouples global layout analysis from local content recognition. In the first stage, the model performs efficient layout analysis on downsampled images to identify structural elements, circumventing the computational overhead of processing high-resolution inputs. In the second stage, guided by the global layout, it performs targeted content recognition on native-resolution crops extracted from the original image, preserving fine-grained details in dense text, complex formulas, and tables. To support this strategy, we developed a comprehensive data engine that generates diverse, large-scale training corpora for both pretraining and fine-tuning. Ultimately, MinerU2.5 demonstrates strong document parsing ability, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, surpassing both general-purpose and domain-specific models across various recognition tasks, while maintaining significantly lower computational overhead.
items.title_zh: MinerU2.5：高效高分辨率文档解析脱钩的视野-语言模型

items.detail: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
items.title_zh: 电影罗尔：推出长期视频的系统框架
items.detail_zh: 不断流转的视频生成必须保持超出培训范围的质量，同时处理自我生成的历史和不断增加的缓存费用。为了应付这些挑战，我们提出了Movie Roll，一个连接流线微调、长卷蒸馏和长视距推论的基础到蒸馏框架。我们首先通过Windows-Windows Teachers Forcing(WinTF)建立一个强大的多步骤基础，它共同将噪声分解为渐进级，并且在每个窗口中双向关注，并因果地访问之前的历史。为了有效地保留历史背景，分级的KV-cache压缩(HieraKV)利用分层的注意模式，在浅层中保留完整的历史，在深层中保留沉积-最近的历史。这可以将缓存内存减少78%，同时提高生成质量。在这个基础上，与分布匹配蒸馏(CulT-DMD)的累积长调值在每次长时间的自滚中保持固定参数，在更新前平均局部梯度。因此，每次更新都将跨时空位置的监督结合起来，同时只保留一个当地计算图，以便能够对几步生成器进行有效的长期推出培训。为了将生成扩展到训练视野以外，KV重算将两种模型的上下文限制在外，而制导式AnnealCFG则减少对清洁端点的引导，以稳定MovieRoll-Base。为了补充这些建模进展，FBCA关注和PS-VAE解码支持高效培训和流化输出。在Helios Bench上，MovieRoll-Base在接受最多15人的视频培训后仍保持30分的竞争力，MovieRoll-Distilled在单项和多项活动评价的比较方法中总分最高，最高达到60分，将持续自然性和主动运动相结合。

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice，这是一种新颖的模型，旨在通过使用近位传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器，这是一种通过传播自旋生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器，与流行的Encodec模型相比，在保持可比性能的同时将数据压缩提高了80倍。标语器有效地保存了音频忠贞性，同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率。因此，VibeVoice可以合成最长90分钟的长式语音(在64K上下文窗口长度)，最多4个扬声器，捕捉真实的对白"vibe'，并超越开源和专有的对话模式。

items.detail: This report describes ARIS (Auto-Research-in-sleep), an open-source research harness for autonomous research, including its architecture, assurance mechanisms, and early deployment experience. The performance of agent systems built on LLMs depends on both the model weights and the harness around them, which governs what information to store, retrieve, and present to the model. For long-horizon research workflows, the central failure mode is not a visible breakdown but a plausible unsupported success: a long-running agent can produce claims whose evidential support is incomplete, misreported, or silently inherited from the executor's framing. Therefore, we present ARIS as a research harness that coordinates machine-learning research workflows through cross-model adversarial collaboration as a default configuration: an executor model drives forward progress while a reviewer from a different model family is recommended to critique intermediate artifacts and request revisions. ARIS has three architectural layers. The execution layer provides more than 65 reusable Markdown-defined skills, model integrations via MCP, a persistent research wiki for iterative reuse of prior findings, and deterministic figure generation. The orchestration layer coordinates five end-to-end workflows with adjustable effort settings and configurable routing to reviewer models. The assurance layer includes a three-stage process for checking whether experimental claims are supported by evidence: integrity verification, result-to-claim mapping, and claim auditing that cross-checks manuscript statements against the claim ledger and raw evidence, as well as a five-pass scientific-editing pipeline, mathematical-proof checks, and visual inspection of the rendered PDF. A prototype self-improvement loop records research traces and proposes harness improvements that are adopted only after reviewer approval.
items.title_zh: ARIS：通过横向多代理协作进行自主研究
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了ARIS(Auto-Reledge-in-sleep)，这是一种用于自主研究的开源研究工具，包括其架构，保证机制，以及早期部署经验。以LLMS为基础的代理系统的性能取决于模型重量及其周围的牵引力，这些牵引力支配着存储、检索和提交模型的信息。对于长视研究工作流程来说，中央故障模式并不是一个明显的崩溃，而是一种可能得不到支持的成功：一个长期运行的代理商可以提出其证据支持不完整，报告错误，或者默默继承自执行人的设定。因此，我们把ARIS作为一个研究工具，通过跨模型对抗性协作协调机器学习研究工作流程，作为默认的配置：一个执行器模型推动进步，而来自不同模型家族的审查员则被推荐批评中间文物并要求修改。 ARIS有三个建筑层。执行层提供了超过65个可重复使用的Markdown定义技能，通过MCP的模型集成，一个用于迭代重用先前发现的持久研究wiki，以及确定性的数字生成。管弦乐层协调五个端到端的工作流程，具有可调整的工作设置和可配置的路由到审查者模型。保证层包括一个三阶段程序，用于检查实验性索赔是否有证据支持：完整性核实、结果对索赔的映射、对照索赔分类账和原始证据对手稿报表进行交叉核对的索赔审计，以及五通科学编辑管道、数学防伪检查和对提供的PDF进行直观检查。一个原型的自改进循环记录研究痕迹，并提议在审查者批准后才采用的利用改进。

items.detail: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.
items.title_zh: WeMM-Video：推动开放源代码-Momni-Modal视频理解的前沿
items.detail_zh: 视频理解，特别是随附音频，仍然是多式联运智能中的一项核心挑战。在本报告中，我们介绍WemM-Video，一个由中英双语全方位模式基础模型组成的家族，跨越2B，4B，9B，35B-A3B变体。以联合视听感知和推理为中心，WemM-Video在混合思维范式内统一文字，图像，音频，视频处理，无缝支持非思维指示模式快速，直接回应，以及明确分步推理的思维模式。通过逐步进行预训和培训后的多阶段培训，对模式进行了约1.2万亿令吉的大规模多式联运培训，其中包括多教师OPD、反重复MRDPO和专家RL。 WeMM-Video通过120多项基准进行了评估，在全方位模式视频理解和推理方面表现优异，同时在一般音频、无声视频、图像和文本任务方面保持高度竞争的能力。具体来说，在全方位模式视频评价中，我们的旗舰WemM-Video-35B-A3B建立了新的开源状态，在缩小与强双子座-3.0-Flash的差距的同时，大幅超越了Quen3.5-Omni-Flash和Seed2.0-Mini-0428等专有模式，我们的紧凑型WemM-Video-9B超越了更大的开源Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。我们公开发布WemM-Video家族，以及我们的评估和复制管道，以促进开放源码社区的进一步研究和开发。

items.title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
items.subtitle: Recent progress in natural language processing has been driven by advances in both model architecture and model pretraining. Transformers is an open-source library with the goal of opening up these advances to the wider machine learning community. items.detail: Recent progress in natural language processing has been driven by advances in both model architecture and model pretraining. Transformer architectures have facilitated building higher-capacity models and pretraining has made it possible to effectively utilize this capacity for a wide variety of tasks. Transformers is an open-source library with the goal of opening up these advances to the wider machine learning community. The library consists of carefully engineered state-of-the art Transformer architectures under a unified API. Backing this library is a curated collection of pretrained models made by and available for the community. Transformers is designed to be extensible by researchers, simple for practitioners, and fast and robust in industrial deployments. items.detail: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.
items.title_zh: 流式三维重建的几何上下文变换器
items.detail_zh: 流3D重建旨在从视频流中恢复相机姿势和点云等3D信息，这需要几何精度，时间一致性和计算效率。受同步本地化和绘图原理(SLAM)的启发，我们引入了LingBot-Map，一种从流数据中重建场景的向导3D基础模型，基于几何背景变换器(GCT)架构。 LingBot-Map的一个决定性方面在于它精心设计的注意机制，它分别融合了锚定上下文，姿势参考窗口，以及处理坐标落地，密度几何提示，以及远程漂移修正的轨迹内存。这种设计保持流体状态紧凑，同时保留丰富的几何上下文，使518×378分辨率输入器在超过10,000帧的长序上能稳定高效地推断出约20个FPS。对各种基准的广泛评价表明，与现有的流式和迭代优化办法相比，我们的方法取得了更好的业绩。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generating contextually coherent responses, yet their fixed context windows pose fundamental challenges for maintaining consistency over prolonged multi-session dialogues. We introduce Mem0, a scalable memory-centric architecture that addresses this issue by dynamically extracting, consolidating, and retrieving salient information from ongoing conversations. Building on this foundation, we further propose an enhanced variant that leverages graph-based memory representations to capture complex relational structures among conversational elements. Through comprehensive evaluations on LOCOMO benchmark, we systematically compare our approaches against six baseline categories: (i) established memory-augmented systems, (ii) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with varying chunk sizes and k-values, (iii) a full-context approach that processes the entire conversation history, (iv) an open-source memory solution, (v) a proprietary model system, and (vi) a dedicated memory management platform. Empirical results show that our methods consistently outperform all existing memory systems across four question categories: single-hop, temporal, multi-hop, and open-domain. Notably, Mem0 achieves 26% relative improvements in the LLM-as-a-Judge metric over OpenAI, while Mem0 with graph memory achieves around 2% higher overall score than the base configuration. Beyond accuracy gains, we also markedly reduce computational overhead compared to full-context method. In particular, Mem0 attains a 91% lower p95 latency and saves more than 90% token cost, offering a compelling balance between advanced reasoning capabilities and practical deployment constraints. Our findings highlight critical role of structured, persistent memory mechanisms for long-term conversational coherence, paving the way for more reliable and efficient LLM-driven AI agents.
items.title_zh: Mem0：搭建具有可伸缩长期记忆的制作- Ready AI代理
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型在生成背景一致的响应方面表现出了显著的优势，但其固定的上下文窗口对在长时间的多会对话中保持一致性构成根本性挑战。我们介绍Mem0，一种可伸缩的以记忆为中心的架构，它通过动态地提取，整合，以及从正在进行的对话中获取显著信息来解决这个问题。在这个基础上，我们进一步提出了一种增强的变体，利用基于图表的内存表达来捕捉对话要素之间的复杂关系结构。通过对LOCOMO基准的全面评价，我们系统地将我们的方法与六个基准类别进行比较：(一) 已建立的内存增强系统，(二) 具有不同块大小和k值的检索增强生成(RAG)，(三) 处理整个对话历史的完整文本方法，(四) 开源内存解决方案，(五) 专有模式系统，(六) 专用内存管理平台。经验结果显示，我们的方法在四个问题类别中，即单跳、时跳、多跳和开放域，持续地超过所有现有的内存系统。值得注意的是，Mem0比OpenAI在LLM-as-a-Judge度量上实现了26%的相对改进，而具有图内存的Mem0的总得分则比基础配置高出约2%。除了准确性提高之外，我们还显著降低了计算间接费用，而不是全文方法。尤其是，Mem0的p95延迟度降低91%，节省了90%以上的象征性费用，在先进的推理能力与实际部署限制之间提供了令人信服的平衡。我们的调查结果突出了结构合理、持久的记忆机制对于长期对话一致性的关键作用，为更可靠、更高效的LLM驱动AI代理铺平了道路。

items.detail: This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the PyTorch distributed data parallel module. PyTorch is a widely-adopted scientific computing package used in deep learning research and applications. Recent advances in deep learning argue for the value of large datasets and large models, which necessitates the ability to scale out model training to more computational resources. Data parallelism has emerged as a popular solution for distributed training thanks to its straightforward principle and broad applicability. In general, the technique of distributed data parallelism replicates the model on every computational resource to generate gradients independently and then communicates those gradients at each iteration to keep model replicas consistent. Despite the conceptual simplicity of the technique, the subtle dependencies between computation and communication make it non-trivial to optimize the distributed training efficiency. As of v1.5, PyTorch natively provides several techniques to accelerate distributed data parallel, including bucketing gradients, overlapping computation with communication, and skipping gradient synchronization. Evaluations show that, when configured appropriately, the PyTorch distributed data parallel module attains near-linear scalability using 256 GPUs.
items.title_zh: PyTorch 分布：加速数据并行培训的经验
items.detail_zh: 本文件介绍了PyTorch分布式数据平行模块的设计、实施和评价。 PyTorch是一个被广泛采纳的科学计算包，用于深层学习研究和应用。近期在深入学习方面的进展论证了大型数据集和大型模型的价值，这就要求有能力将模型培训扩大到更多的计算资源。由于数据平行原则的直截了当和广泛适用性，数据平行主义已成为分发培训的受欢迎的解决办法。一般来说，分布式数据平行主义的技术复制了每个计算资源上的模式来独立生成梯度，然后在每个迭代上传达出这些梯度来保持模型复制的一致性。尽管技术在概念上很简洁，但计算和通信之间的微妙依赖性使得优化分布式培训效率成为非三角性。截至v1.5，PyTorch本土提供了几种技术来加速分布式数据平行，包括桶式梯度，与通信相重叠的计算，并跳过梯度同步。评价显示，PyTorch分布式数据平行模块在适当配置时，使用256GPU实现近线性可扩展性。

items.detail: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce MedJev, a system one vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, MedJev removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, MedJev-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of 7.93\% and a 6.04times end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that MedJev-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.
items.title_zh: MedJev：快速有效的医疗图像理解系统一愿景-语言决定模型
items.detail_zh: 具有视觉语言模型(VLMs)的医学图像理解通常依赖于自动生成推理和回答符号。这些不必要的符号使推论成本尺度与响应长度相配合，并迫使答案从自由格式文本中解析，从而发生可避免的延迟和决定错误。为此，我们引入了MedJev，这是一个系统，它是一个视觉语言决策模型，它可以绘制医疗图像、问题和候选者直接回答一个单一的多式联运前传中的决定，而没有任何自动生成过程。对于快速推论，MedJev移除了上语言层和基因输出路径，同时保留了完整的视觉路径和所有视觉符号。在这个缩短的骨干上，一个决定头通过预先训练的查询键比对每个考生来评分，并用轻量级多层受体(MLP)残基来精炼分数，将预先训练的比对结构与特定任务的非线性歧视结合起来。建于Quen3.5-4B上，MedJev-4B在四个医学影像分类和视觉问题答题基准上，均比原模型提高精度和速度，绝对精度增益7.93×××，6.04次终到速。与20个前沿模型的进一步比较表明，MedJev-4B在4B-9B通用和医学VLM中实现了最先进的性能和推论速度，表明直接的多式联运决策是快速有效的医疗图像理解的有效途径。

items.detail: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
items.title_zh: 热化：系统一个模型现在生成
items.detail_zh: 系统 一个模型，如Jev通过快速，平行的预测返回决定。在本文中，我们介绍了Jeveration，表明同样的决定范式也可以在一次前传中产生高质量的图像。 Jeveration以冷冻的视觉语言模式为基础，将其视觉语义知识重新用于整体图像生成。主要挑战是保持全球一致性。单一的提示承认了许多有效的图像，但并行的预测必须一致地形成一个连贯的整体。因此，我们把所有立场都建立在共同的随机状态上，以协调平行的预测，这样每一幅图都会产生不同但一致的形象。由于模型倾向于在直接的图像监督下忽略这种状态，我们首先在离散的图像代码上学习分布，以引导单传生成。除了文本到图像生成之外，我们进一步将图像到图像生成和密集的预测统一在同一架构内，这样一个检查点就能支持所有三项任务，每个任务都以一个前传的方式进行。实验显示，Jeveration在78ms中生成512x512图像，最高速度比现有的统一模型快122x，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量和密集的预测性能。

items.detail: We introduce PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, an upgraded compact document parsing model built upon PaddleOCR-VL-1.5. Although PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 establishes a strong 0.9B baseline, its remaining errors concentrate in under-optimized regions where model behavior is unstable, data coverage is sparse, or supervision is unreliable. Rather than expanding the training corpus indiscriminately, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 introduces a region-aware data optimization framework that identifies weak regions from the previous model, applies targeted enhancement to these regions, and improves the reliability of supervision signals. It further adopts a progressive post-training recipe based on curated data selection and reinforcement learning, pushing model performance to a higher level through staged optimization. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 achieves a new state-of-the-art score of 96.33% on OmniDocBench v1.6, demonstrates strong competitiveness against top-tier VLMs, and provides a practical post-training recipe for the PaddleOCR-VL series.
items.title_zh: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6：扩展文件解析范围与未优化区域 完善和渐进后培训
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了PaddleOCR-VL-1.6，这是一个基于PaddleOCR-VL-1.5的升级压缩文件解析模型。尽管PaddleOCR-VL-1.5确立了一个强大的0.9B基线，但其剩余错误集中在模型行为不稳定、数据覆盖不足或监管不可靠的地区。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6没有不加区别地扩大培训内容，而是引入了一个区域意识数据优化框架，从以前的模型中找出薄弱区域，对这些区域进行有针对性的增强，并提高监督信号的可靠性。它进一步采用了基于整理数据选择和强化学习的渐进式培训后方法，通过分阶段优化将模型性能推向更高水平。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.33%的新高分数，表现出了对顶级VLM的强大竞争力，并为PaddleOCR-VL系列提供了实用的训练后配方。

items.detail: The success of large-scale pre-training paradigm, exemplified by Large Language Models (LLMs), has inspired the development of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs). However, their application to financial candlestick (K-line) data remains limited, often underperforming non-pre-trained architectures. Moreover, existing TSFMs often overlook crucial downstream tasks such as volatility prediction and synthetic data generation. To address these limitations, we propose Kronos, a unified, scalable pre-training framework tailored to financial K-line modeling. Kronos introduces a specialized tokenizer that discretizes continuous market information into token sequences, preserving both price dynamics and trade activity patterns. We pre-train Kronos using an autoregressive objective on a massive, multi-market corpus of over 12 billion K-line records from 45 global exchanges, enabling it to learn nuanced temporal and cross-asset representations. Kronos excels in a zero-shot setting across a diverse set of financial tasks. On benchmark datasets, Kronos boosts price series forecasting RankIC by 93% over the leading TSFM and 87% over the best non-pre-trained baseline. It also achieves a 9% lower MAE in volatility forecasting and a 22% improvement in generative fidelity for synthetic K-line sequences. These results establish Kronos as a robust, versatile foundation model for end-to-end financial time series analysis. Our pre-trained model is publicly available at https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos.
items.title_zh: Kronos：面向金融市场 K 线语言的基础模型
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)为典型的大规模培训前范式的成功，启发了时代系列基础模型(TSFM)的发展。然而，它们在金融烛台(K线)数据的应用仍然有限，往往表现不佳的未经事先培训的架构。此外，现有的TSFMs往往忽略了波动预测和合成数据生成等关键的下游任务。为了克服这些限制，我们提议克罗诺斯(Kronos)，一个适合财务K线模型化的统一，可扩展的预培训框架。克罗诺斯引入了一种专门的代号器，将连续的市场信息曲解成代号序列，同时保留价格动态和贸易活动模式。我们预先训练克罗诺斯 利用一个自旋目标 在一个巨大的，多市场 超过120亿K线记录 从45个全球交易所，使其能够学习 细微的时间和跨资产表述。 Kronos在零镜头的设定中表现优异，跨越了各种财务任务。在基准数据集上，Kronos将价格系列预测RankIC比领先的TSFM提升93%，比最佳非预培训基线提升87%。它还在波动性预测中实现了9%的MAE，合成K线序列的基因忠诚度提高了22%。这些结果将Kronos确立为一个强有力的多功能的基础模型，用于对端到端的财务时间序列进行分析。我们经过预先培训的模型可在https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos上公开查阅。
items.subtitle_zh: 大规模预训练推动了时间序列基础模型的发展，但这些模型用于金融 K 线数据时仍经常不如专门训练的架构，也容易忽略波动率预测、合成数据生成等下游任务。Kronos 提出面向金融 K 线的统一、可扩展预训练框架：使用专用 Tokenizer 将连续市场信息离散化，同时保留价格变化与交易活动模式，并在涵盖全球多个交易所的大规模跨市场 K 线数据上进行自回归预训练，以学习跨时间和资产的表示。

items.detail: We introduce SmolDocling, an ultra-compact vision-language model targeting end-to-end document conversion. Our model comprehensively processes entire pages by generating DocTags, a new universal markup format that captures all page elements in their full context with location. Unlike existing approaches that rely on large foundational models, or ensemble solutions that rely on handcrafted pipelines of multiple specialized models, SmolDocling offers an end-to-end conversion for accurately capturing content, structure and spatial location of document elements in a 256M parameters vision-language model. SmolDocling exhibits robust performance in correctly reproducing document features such as code listings, tables, equations, charts, lists, and more across a diverse range of document types including business documents, academic papers, technical reports, patents, and forms -- significantly extending beyond the commonly observed focus on scientific papers. Additionally, we contribute novel publicly sourced datasets for charts, tables, equations, and code recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that SmolDocling competes with other Vision Language Models that are up to 27 times larger in size, while reducing computational requirements substantially. The model is currently available, datasets will be publicly available soon.
items.title_zh: SmolDocling：用于端到端多模式文件转换的超共性视觉语言模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍SmolDocling，一种超共性视觉语言模型，瞄准端到端文档转换。我们的模型通过生成 DocTags 来全面处理整个页面，这是一种新的通用的标记格式，它将所有页面元素与位置完全结合。与依赖大型基础模型的现有方法，或依赖多种专业模型的手动管道的共聚解决方案不同，SmolDocling提供了一个端到端的转换，以便在256M参数视觉语言模型中准确捕捉文件元素的内容，结构和空间位置。 SmolDocling在正确复制文件特征(例如代码列表、表格、方程式、图表、清单)方面表现出强劲的性能，在包括商业文件、学术论文、技术报告、专利和表格在内的各种文件类型中表现得更多 -- -- 大大超出了通常观察到的科学论文重点。此外，我们还提供图表、表格、方程式和代码识别等新的公开来源数据集。实验结果显示，SmolDocling与其他尺寸可达27倍的Vision语言模型竞争，同时大幅降低了计算要求。目前已有该模型，数据集将很快公开。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for expanding Large Language Models beyond their static training limitations. However, a critical misalignment exists between current RAG capabilities and real-world information environments. Modern knowledge repositories are inherently multimodal, containing rich combinations of textual content, visual elements, structured tables, and mathematical expressions. Yet existing RAG frameworks are limited to textual content, creating fundamental gaps when processing multimodal documents. We present RAG-Anything, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities. Our approach reconceptualizes multimodal content as interconnected knowledge entities rather than isolated data types. The framework introduces dual-graph construction to capture both cross-modal relationships and textual semantics within a unified representation. We develop cross-modal hybrid retrieval that combines structural knowledge navigation with semantic matching. This enables effective reasoning over heterogeneous content where relevant evidence spans multiple modalities. RAG-Anything demonstrates superior performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Performance gains become particularly pronounced on long documents where traditional approaches fail. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems. Our framework is open-sourced at: https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything.
items.title_zh: RAG-任何东西：全能的RAG框架
items.detail_zh: 检索-增强型一代(RAG)已成为超越其静态训练限制扩展大语言模型的基本范例。然而，目前的RAG能力和现实世界的信息环境之间存在严重的错位。现代知识库本质上是多模式的，包含丰富的文字内容组合，视觉元素，结构化的表格和数学表达。然而，现有的RAG框架仅限于文本内容，在处理多式文件时造成了根本的空白。我们提出 " RAG-Anything "，这是一个统一的框架，能够对所有模式进行全面的知识检索。我们的方法将多式联运内容重新定义为相互关联的知识实体，而不是孤立的数据类型。该框架引入了双图构建，在统一代表制内既抓住了跨模式关系，又抓住了文字语义。我们开发了将结构知识导航与语义匹配相结合的跨模式混合检索。在相关证据涉及多种模式的情况下，这样就能够对不同内容进行有效推理。 RAG-任何东西都显示出在挑战性多式联运基准方面的优异表现，比最先进的方法有了重大的改进。在传统办法失败的长文件中，业绩收益特别明显。我们的框架为获得多模式知识确立了新的范式，消除了制约现有系统的建筑分化。我们的框架开放来源于：https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything。

items.detail: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems significantly advance over traditional turn-based dialogue systems, as they allow simultaneous bidirectional communication, closely mirroring human-human interactions. However, achieving low latency and natural interactions in full-duplex dialogue systems remains a significant challenge, especially considering human conversation dynamics such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. In this paper, we introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex conversation, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations with low latency. To achieve full-duplex communication capabilities, we propose a multi-stage post-training scheme that progressively adapts a text-based large language model (LLM) backbone into a speech-text dialogue LLM, capable of generating text and speech in real time, without modifying the architecture of the backbone LLM. The training process comprises three stages: modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue learning, and full-duplex dialogue learning. Throughout all training stages, we standardize the data using a flattening operation, which allows us to unify the training methods and the model architecture across different modalities and tasks. Our approach offers a straightforward modeling technique and a promising research direction for developing efficient and natural end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. Audio samples of dialogues generated by OmniFlatten can be found at this web site (https://omniflatten.github.io/).
items.title_zh: OmniFlatten：无缝语音对话的端对端GPT模型
items.detail_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统比传统的回合式对话系统大有进步，因为它们可以同时进行双向交流，密切地反映人与人之间的互动。然而，在全复式对话系统中实现低延迟和自然互动仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是考虑到人的对话动态，如中断、后通道和重叠的言论。在本文中，我们引入了以端对端GPT为基础的小说模型OmniFlatten，用于全复式对话，能够有效模拟低纬度的自然对话所固有的复杂行为。为了实现全方位的交流能力，我们提出一个多阶段的后培训计划，将基于文本的大型语言模型(LLM)主干逐步改编为语音-文本对话LLM，能够实时生成文本和语音，而不修改主干LLM的结构。培训过程包括三个阶段：模式调整、半复式对话学习和全复式对话学习。在所有培训阶段，我们使用一个平整操作使数据标准化，使我们能够统一不同模式和任务的训练方法和示范结构。我们的方法为发展高效的、自然的、端到端的完全复杂的口语对话系统提供了直接的建模技术和有希望的研究方向。在该网站(https://omniflatten.github.io/)可以找到OmniFlatten生成的对话框的音频样本。

items.title: LongCat-Video Technical Report
items.subtitle: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks
items.detail: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks enables LongCat-Video to maintain high quality and temporal coherence in the generation of minutes-long videos; Efficient inference: LongCat-Video generates 720p, 30fps videos within minutes by employing a coarse-to-fine generation strategy along both the temporal and spatial axes. Block Sparse Attention further enhances efficiency, particularly at high resolutions; Strong performance with multi-reward RLHF: Multi-reward RLHF training enables LongCat-Video to achieve performance on par with the latest closed-source and leading open-source models. Code and model weights are publicly available to accelerate progress in the field.
items.detail_zh: 视频生成是走向世界模型的关键途径，以高效的长视频推论为关键能力。为此，我们引入了"长卡特-视频"(LongCat-Video)，这是一个具有13.6B参数的基础视频生成模型，在多个视频生成任务中展现出强效。它在高效和高质量的长相视频制作方面特别出色，代表了我们走向世界模式的第一步。主要功能包括：多个任务的统一架构：构建在分化变形器(DiT)框架上，LongCat-Video支持Text-to-Video，Image-Video，以及视频连续任务，采用单一模式；长视频生成：关于视频连续任务的预训，使LongCat-Video能够在生成分钟视频时保持高质量和时间上的一致性；高效推论：LongCat-Video在几分钟内通过在时间轴和空间轴上同时使用粗到fine生成策略生成720p，30fps视频。 Block Sparse Content进一步提高了效率，特别是在高分辨率下；强效多奖RLHF：多奖RLHF训练使LongCat-Video能够以与最新封闭源码和领先开源模式等同的方式实现性能。守则和模型权重已公开提供，以加速该领域的进展。

items.title: InCoder-32B: Code Foundation Model for Industrial Scenarios
items.subtitle: Recent code large language models have achieved remarkable progress on general programming tasks. items.detail: Recent code large language models have achieved remarkable progress on general programming tasks. Nevertheless, their performance degrades significantly in industrial scenarios that require reasoning about hardware semantics, specialized language constructs, and strict resource constraints. To address these challenges, we introduce InCoder-32B (Industrial-Coder-32B), the first 32B-parameter code foundation model unifying code intelligence across chip design, GPU kernel optimization, embedded systems, compiler optimization, and 3D modeling. By adopting an efficient architecture, we train InCoder-32B from scratch with general code pre-training, curated industrial code annealing, mid-training that progressively extends context from 8K to 128K tokens with synthetic industrial reasoning data, and post-training with execution-grounded verification. We conduct extensive evaluation on 14 mainstream general code benchmarks and 9 industrial benchmarks spanning 4 specialized domains. Results show InCoder-32B achieves highly competitive performance on general tasks while establishing strong open-source baselines across industrial domains.
items.title_zh: InCoder-32B：工业情景代码基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近代码大语言模型在一般编程任务上取得了显著进展。尽管如此，它们的性能在需要硬件语义推理，专业语言构造，以及严格的资源限制的工业情景中显著下降。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了InCoder-32B(Industrial-Coder-32B)，这是第一个32B参数代码基础模型，将代码智能统一到芯片设计，GPU内核优化，嵌入式系统，编译器优化，以及3D建模。通过采用高效的架构，我们从头开始训练InCoder-32B，进行一般代码预训，解析工业代码反射，中训逐渐将背景从8K扩展至128K的代币，进行合成工业推理数据，后训则进行基于执行的核查。我们广泛评价14项主流一般守则基准和9项涵盖4个专门领域的工业基准。结果表明，InCoder-32B在一般任务上取得了高度竞争性的业绩，同时在工业领域建立了强有力的开放源码软件基线。

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. items.detail: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose VoxMel, a tokenizer-free framework for autoregressive TTS that makes stable mel modeling tractable through a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. The transform first decomposes each mel spectrogram along frequency into local averages and a frequency residual, then splits the averaged component along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual. A language-model backbone with a flow-matching head autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel. Non-autoregressive residual tiers then predict the temporal residual from Coarse-Mel, followed by the frequency residual conditioned on the reconstructed Frequency-Averaged Mel. Neither residual is fed back into the autoregressive history. Trained on 100K hours of Emilia, the supervised 0.6B model obtains 1.51\% WER and 0.738 speaker similarity (SIM) on test-en, and 1.29\% CER and 0.755 SIM on test-zh. GRPO improves these results to 1.15\% WER / 0.753 SIM and 1.17\% CER / 0.776 SIM, respectively. We also distill the guided flow head into two- and four-step students, requiring 2 or 4 head evaluations per coarse frame. The four-step student retains competitive SIM and nearly matches the supervised model in WER/CER.
items.detail_zh: 持续的自递式TTS依赖于一个声学目标，这个目标在保存精细纹理的声学细节的同时，能够实现稳定的近端建模。虽然现有方法利用学到的压缩表示(如连续的VAE潜伏物)使预测具有可拉动性，但它们依赖于复杂的神经编码器，这些编码器往往限制生成忠诚度。反之，无培训目标，如Mel-光谱仪，消除了编码器的间接费用，但其自动生成的潜力在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用。在这部作品中，我们提出VoxMel，一个自递式TTS的无标本框架，通过固定的，完全不可逆的两轴Haar变换，使稳定的mel模型可拉动。变换先将每个mel光谱沿频率分解成局部平均值和一个频率残基，然后将平均元件沿时间分解成粗毛-梅尔和一个时间残基。具有流配头自动递归性生成粗糙-梅尔的语言型骨干。非自动还原性残留级然后预测来自粗毛耳的时间残留，然后预测重建的频率-经测算的梅尔的频率残留条件。任何剩余部分都不会被反馈到自动倒退的历史中。在Emilia100K小时的训练中，被监督的0.6B型号在测试中获得了1.51QQWER和0.738扬声器相似度(SIM)，在测试中获得了1.29QCER和0.755SIM。 GRPO将这些结果分别改进为1.15++WER / 0.753 SIM和1.17+CER / 0.776 SIM。我们还将导流头蒸馏成两步和四步的学生，每粗框需要2或4个头评价。四步学生保留有竞争力的SIM，并几乎与WER/CER中的受监督模式相匹配。

items.detail: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. We describe the artifact contract, generation workflow, correction lifecycle, deployment surface, and domain presets implemented in the open-source system. At the time of writing, the public repository has approximately 18.5k GitHub stars; the gallery lists 215 skills from 165 contributors and more than 100k cumulative stars across listed skill cards. The system illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.
items.title_zh: COLLEAGUE.SKILLL：通过专家知识扭曲实现自动AI技能生成
items.detail_zh: 人们日益期望LLM代理人不仅完成孤立的任务，而且还要承担人的专门知识、判断和互动风格的有限表述。建立这种以人为基础的代理人仍然很困难，因为与一个人或角色有关的可操作的知识通常嵌入各种痕迹，而不是写成干净的指示。现有的内存和人名系统收集这些证据的碎片，而技能框架则提供便携式包装格式；然而，没有从端到端的工作流程将这些痕迹分馏成可检查、可纠正和可用剂的技能。我们提出一个自动追踪技能蒸馏系统，通过专家知识蒸馏产生个人的人工智能技能。由于来自目标人或角色的材料，COLLEAGUE.SKILL制作了一个版本技能包，有两条协调的音轨：练习能力音轨，心理模型和决定heuristics，以及交流风格，互动规则，以及校正历史的限定行为音轨。该套件可以检查，引用，通过自然语言反馈更新，回滚，跨代理主机安装，并可选择为控制发行做准备。我们描述了在开源系统中实施的文物合同、生成工作流程、修正生命周期、部署表面和域预设。在写作时，公共寄存器大约有18.5k GitHub星；画廊列出了165名贡献者的215个技能，以及超过100k的累计恒星横跨列表技能卡。该系统说明个人定位技能如何能够被表现为便携式，可纠正的包，而不是不透明的提示或隐藏的记忆。

items.detail: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.
items.title_zh: FastFrames：互动空档的视频生成
items.detail_zh: 自动回归式视频传播模型基于新的观察和投入生成帧，使其成为互动视觉体验的有希望的媒介。然而，对于流体相互作用而言，现有的模型数量级太慢。本文引入了FastFrames，这是一组快速自旋式视频传播模式，在不损及质量的情况下实现互动性延时。我们剖析了最先进的模型的推论管道，发现操作经常作为固定执行细节处理，如VAE解码和KV缓存更新，实际上占到端到端推论延迟的一半以上。我们对这些组成部分不可或缺并用轻量级替代品取代的假设提出质疑。我们的1.3B变体运行在单个B200GPU上，每帧36ms，或每秒28个响应(RPS)，同时匹配近8x慢的先进型号的生成质量。我们的14B变体在8x B200 GPU节点上运行，每帧45ms，或22 RTS，并产生显著的更好的视觉质量和现实性。我们显示 FastFrames 可以实时交互应用，例如相机和物理设备的视频生成。

items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26：统一实时端对端视野模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确，高效，简便的模型，以在各种硬件中部署。 YOLO家族因此被广泛部署，然而大多数YOLO探测器在推论上仍然依赖非最大压制，由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头，需要较长的训练时间表，可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务。我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26，这是一个统一的实时视野模型家族，通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性。 YOLO26为本土NMS无端对端推论使用双头设计，并完全去除DFL，产生一个没有约束的回归范围的较轻头。其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合的Muon-SGD优化器，根据大型语言模式培训加以调整；进步损失，将监督转向推论时间头；和STAL，一种标签分配策略，它保证对小物体的正面覆盖。除检测外，YOLO26还引入了特定任务头和损失设计，例如分解，提出估计和定向检测，在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益。家族跨越5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x)，支持检测，实例分解，在单一的管道中提出估计，分类，并定向检测，并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展，YOLOE-26，用于文本，视觉，以及即时的免费推断。在所有尺度上，YOLO26在COCO上以1.7至11.8 ms T4 TensorRT的耐久性达到40.9至57.5 mAP，将精度-常帕雷托正面推进到之前的实时探测器上，而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP。代码和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics。

items.detail: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.
items.title_zh: OmniEdu：开放的学习和教学基础模式
items.detail_zh: 教育基础模式必须解决问题，了解课程结构，诊断学习者的困难，并提供适当的教学支持。现有的教育语言模式往往侧重于解决问题或辅导，培训混合物按来源或任务而不是能力来安排。我们介绍OmniEdu，一个开放的K-12学习和教学的基础模式家庭。其教学调校法将100多家教育资源和一般教学来源结合起来，围绕四个能力组织：学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动和脚手架。我们的管道将确定性清洁、语义审计和重写、特定任务的质量评分、象征性预算的多样性选择以及教学指导任务结合起来。它产生了69 999个实例和15 96M监督反应标志，包括60 951个教育特有实例。我们微调4B、9B和27B模式，评估课程基础、K-12问题的解决和教学辅导以及一般能力。以教育为导向的调整不断改善所有三个教育基准组的示范规模。 OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench上实现63.12%EM和76.69%F1，在MathFish上达到85.89%，在EDUMATH上达到86.95%，在MathTutor Bench的脚手架设置上达到78.74%。它还在被评价的模型中实现了LongTutor教学平均最高，为3.02。这些结果表明，在使通用语言模式适应解决各种问题、理解课程和提供教学支持等教育任务方面，经过管理、能力平衡的监督很有价值。

items.detail: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.
items.title_zh: ZeroVLN：在无监督的情况下学习导航 VLM脑的精细化
items.detail_zh: 具有代表性的视觉语言导航(VLN)方法通常将一个视觉语言模型(VLM)大脑与可学习的动作头结合，并在导航域数据上微调VLM大脑，以预测几何目标。然而，这种适应可大大改变基本的VLM重量，并降低一般的视觉能力。我们引入了ZeroVLN，一个以VLM大脑零导航域SFT实现有效导航的慢速导航框架。我们不是教大脑预测几何目标，而是为大脑配备一个语义工具调用接口，用于将运动决定传递给一位自然语言的动作专家。我们首先调整行动专家来执行这些运动请求，然后通过闭路强化学习(RL)共同改进大脑的运动决定和行动专家的连续执行。 ZeroVLN在相同的导航事件中接受了训练，在标准VLN-CE(连续环境)基准上，其具有代表性的基于SFT的分级VLN方法的性能大大超过其性能，同时只能诱导大脑重量的微小变化，并基本保持其一般能力。据我们所知，ZeroVLN是第一个具有VLM大脑零导航域SFT的慢速VLN框架，也是第一个通过VLN-CE的闭路代理RL共同优化其慢速政策。
