items.detail: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as π_{0.5} and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

items.detail_zh: 陶瓷感知是接触力强的狡猾操纵不可或缺的方式，这种能力暗示着所体现智能的最终前沿。然而，商业上可用的触觉传感器仍处于相对较早的发展阶段，每一种传感器除了本身的缺点之外，还具有不可替代的优点。因此，一个关键挑战是从传感器特定物理学中释放触觉理解，这样所包含模型就可以有效地利用各种触觉数据。为此，我们开发了LingBot-Touch，一种具有以下特性的触觉基础模型。 (一) 我们的模型在不同触觉感应器(即偏振感应器、磁性感应器和粘度感应器)之间产生统一的表示，并易于推广到新的感应器类型。 (二) 由此产生的触觉符号是插图和游戏：它们可以无缝地融入跨范式的政策模型，从传播政策到视觉语言行动(VLA)模型，如XQ0.5}和LingBot-VLA，不断增强操纵的节奏。 (三)跨越模拟和在多个硬件平台进行实际机器人部署的广泛实验，表明我们的触觉表现在保持强大计算效率的同时，大大有利于复杂的操纵任务。我们认为，这项工作的调查结果表明，利用跨传感器数据扩大触觉学习的潜力，并为未来硬件和体现模式的设计提供了令人鼓舞的见解。

items.detail: Synthesizing visual content that meets users' needs often requires flexible and precise controllability of the pose, shape, expression, and layout of the generated objects. Existing approaches gain controllability of generative adversarial networks (GANs) via manually annotated training data or a prior 3D model, which often lack flexibility, precision, and generality. In this work, we study a powerful yet much less explored way of controlling GANs, that is, to "drag" any points of the image to precisely reach target points in a user-interactive manner, as shown in Fig.1. To achieve this, we propose DragGAN, which consists of two main components: 1) a feature-based motion supervision that drives the handle point to move towards the target position, and 2) a new point tracking approach that leverages the discriminative generator features to keep localizing the position of the handle points. Through DragGAN, anyone can deform an image with precise control over where pixels go, thus manipulating the pose, shape, expression, and layout of diverse categories such as animals, cars, humans, landscapes, etc. As these manipulations are performed on the learned generative image manifold of a GAN, they tend to produce realistic outputs even for challenging scenarios such as hallucinating occluded content and deforming shapes that consistently follow the object's rigidity. Both qualitative and quantitative comparisons demonstrate the advantage of DragGAN over prior approaches in the tasks of image manipulation and point tracking. We also showcase the manipulation of real images through GAN inversion.
items.title_zh: 拖动您的 GAN：基于 Generative 图像 Manifold 的互动点操纵
items.detail_zh: 合成满足用户需要的视觉内容，往往需要灵活而精确地控制生成对象的姿势，形状，表达和布局。现有办法通过手动附加说明的培训数据或先前的三维模型获得基因对抗网络的可控性，这些模型往往缺乏灵活性、精确性和普遍性。在这部作品中，我们研究了一种强大的但更没有被探索过的控制GAN的方法，即"抹去"图像的任何点，以用户交互的方式精确到达目标点，如图1所示。为此，我们提议DragGAN，它由两个主要部分组成：1)基于特性的运动监督，推动手柄点向目标位置移动；2)新的点追踪方法，利用歧视性的生成器特征，使手柄点的位置保持本地化。通过DragGAN，任何人都可以对像素去向进行精确控制，从而操纵动物，汽车，人类，景观等多种类别的姿势，形状，表现和布局来变形。由于这些操纵是用一个GAN的遗传图象的学问倍数进行的，因此它们往往产生现实的输出，甚至对于具有挑战性的情景，如幻觉吞噬内容和不断遵循物体刚性而变形的形状。定性和定量比较表明，DragGAN在图像操纵和点跟踪任务中比以往的方法更有利。我们也通过GAN反演展现了对真实图像的操纵。

items.detail: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons using the same checkpoint, experts prefer symbolic planning for overall quality and musicality, with 49.3% of overall preferences versus 34.6% without planning. Experts also favor the unified model over a separate language model and diffusion Transformer. On WildSongBench, YuE2 scores 6.73 on SongBench Global Avg, exceeding all evaluated public baselines. Selecting from eight candidates (best-of-8), YuE2 reaches 6.96, the highest observed mean among all evaluated systems. Expert listening further establishes its competitiveness with proprietary song generators, favoring best-of-8 over Suno v4.5 and yielding nearly balanced preferences against Suno v5. To learn this generation process from recordings without aligned scores, we introduce MERT2 and SheetSage2 to supply semantic and symbolic supervision. MERT2 sets a new state of the art in music representation learning, surpassing previous best results on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics; SheetSage2 leads 12 of 15 benchmark-metric pairs in our lead-sheet transcription comparison. The same checkpoint follows score edits while largely preserving unedited musical content and generates zero-shot covers without cover-specific training. Its readable score also enables agentic music editing, with external language models translating user feedback into revisions of the composition.
items.title_zh: YUE2：统一符号和音频音乐生成，以前沿质量
items.detail_zh: 符号模型使旋律，和谐，节奏，并形成清晰但一般在完成录制之前停止；音频模型产生完整的歌曲，同时隐含成分。我们介绍YUE2，它通过象征性的规划，统一了象征和音频音乐的制作，具有前沿质量。单曲AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers(MOT)首先写了一个可读的分数，指定了旋律与和谐，将其扩展为语义音乐符号，并实现为全声乐。在使用同一检查站进行比较时，专家倾向于对整体质量和音乐性进行象征性规划，49.3%的总体偏好，34.6%没有规划。专家们也赞成统一模式，而不是单独的语言模式和传播变形器。在WildSong Bench上，YuE2在Song Bench Global Avg上得分6.73，超过了所有评价的公共基线。从8名候选人(最佳8名)中挑选，YUE2达到6.96，是所有被评价系统中观察到的最高平均值。专家的倾听进一步确立了其与专有歌曲生成器的竞争力，倾向于优胜8胜于Suno v4.5，并产生对Suno v5的近乎平衡的偏好。为了从没有对齐分数的录音中学习这个生成过程，我们引入了MERT2和SeetSage2来提供语义和符号监督。 MERT2设定了音乐表现学习的新艺术水平，超越了15个MARBLE 度量衡中的14个的以往最佳成绩； SheetSage2 领先了15个基准度量配对中的12个，在我们的铅板抄录比较中。同一检查点遵循分数编辑，同时基本上保留未经编辑的音乐内容，并产生零镜头封面，而不进行特定封面训练。它的可读分数也使得代理音乐编辑成为可能，外部语言模型将用户反馈翻译为对构成的修订。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep：代理内存的时空知识图架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep，这是AI代理的新记忆层服务，在深记忆检索(DMR)基准中，它的表现超过了目前最先进的系统MemGPT。此外，Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优异，能够更好地反映现实世界的企业使用案例。虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理商的现有检索-增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索，但企业应用程序需要从不同来源，包括正在进行的对话和业务数据，进行动态知识整合。 Zep通过它的核心成分Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎，在保持历史关系的同时，动态地合成非结构的对话数据和结构化的商业数据。在作为主要评价指标的多指标类集调查小组制定的DMR基准中，Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。除了DMR，泽普的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准进一步验证，通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业的使用案例。在本次评价中，泽普取得了实质性成果，精度提高高达18.5%，同时与基线实施相比，反应延迟度降低了90%。这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出，显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果。

items.detail: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is a long-running standard for clustering, with applications in data analysis, retrieval, quantization and data curation. In this paper, we introduce an exponential moving average optimization procedure for k-means with mini-batch updates, powered by modern deep learning machinery and new insights. We also establish scaling laws on how decay rate and batch size impact final performance. This gives us a formulaic rule to fix them for multiple problem sizes and embedding datasets, without the need for any hyperparameter sweep. The resulting clustering algorithm, coined e-means, is much faster than Lloyd k-means and converges to lower losses, frequently even beating k-means++. On a wide array of embeddings datasets, it beats the loss of Lloyd k-means at 25 epochs in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, which translates to 10-45x GPU wall-clock speedups compared to state-of-the-art k-means implementations. As an example, e-means partitions DINO10B, a dataset of 10 billion DINO embeddings, into 16 million clusters in only 2.5 epochs, reaching a loss below Lloyd's at 25 epochs.

items.detail: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
items.detail_zh: 录像制作方面的最新进展要求以明确的法医证据为基础进行可靠的探测。然而，目前的方法主要取决于忽略简短或局部文物的单一思维链推理，或预先界定的多代理人工作流程，这些流程在选择相关检查方面提供有限的灵活性。即使进行了适应性调查，仅优化调查政策并不能直接提高固定专家的法证能力。我们介绍We VisForensics，一个代理框架，在这个框架内，一个主要调查人员协调一个自演的法医检查员子代理人图书馆，这些代理人跨越视觉和音频提示。调查员了解需要检查的文物类型、哪个窗口和何时结束，这些互动为两个级别的代理人提供了共同的反馈。我们的双时级政策优化战略，即DTPO，通过快速加强调查员的学习和在附加说明的文物间隔指导下对视察员进行较慢的改进，以报告他们曾经丢弃的微妙文物，从而结束了这一循环。此外，我们管理ForenCue-30K，将特定角色的法证说明和互动轨迹结合起来，监督个别检查及其协调，并配有一个辅助性强化学习人才库。实验显示，WeVisForensics的检测精度平均为95.2%，跨越域内，域外和代理基准，比最强的先前探测器高9.0%，同时以局部证据作为判断依据。

items.subtitle: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.
items.title_zh: 代码世界模型2.0：迈向无限可控视频生成
items.detail_zh: 视觉代理将清晰的世界状态模拟从光现实主义视频合成中解析，为离线剪辑的创建和实时互动流提供了可控界面。然而，一个实际的表述者必须应对两个挑战。上游代词因相互作用而异，从粗糙的布局到精细的清晰的几何图形，流线推论必须在几个因果步骤中运行，而不会积累跨越自产生历史的漂移。我们提出Invoker-Render，将双向创建模型与一个因果四步流线模型在结构代词的共享条件界面下对齐，外观参考，语言。 Invoker-Render对大约200小时的多角体进行训练，在提供时遵守精细的几何限制，同时在粗细的代用物下合成合理的局部运动，从而能够选择输入细节。为了搭桥双向创建和实时流线，而不复合步骤压缩和展开漂移，我们引入了进步推进(Proforcing)。利用从培训视频中得出的历史，先对因果预测器进行检测，然后将其蒸馏成四步渲染器。然后，培训转向不断自行推出。一个管道式服务堆栈支持高效的流线推论。实验显示，在代理家庭、颗粒物和相机路径方面，具有多功能的控制力，与最近的流线基线相比，取得了持续的进展，并且稳定地进行了30分钟的赛车推广，以保持场景和标的外观。

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for valuation and investment decision-making. Traditional NLP models, however, are limited by their parameter size and the scope of their training datasets, which hampers their generalization capabilities and effectiveness in this field. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) pre-trained on extensive corpora have demonstrated superior performance across various NLP tasks due to their commendable zero-shot abilities. Yet, directly applying LLMs to financial sentiment analysis presents challenges: The discrepancy between the pre-training objective of LLMs and predicting the sentiment label can compromise their predictive performance. Furthermore, the succinct nature of financial news, often devoid of sufficient context, can significantly diminish the reliability of LLMs' sentiment analysis. To address these challenges, we introduce a retrieval-augmented LLMs framework for financial sentiment analysis. This framework includes an instruction-tuned LLMs module, which ensures LLMs behave as predictors of sentiment labels, and a retrieval-augmentation module which retrieves additional context from reliable external sources. Benchmarked against traditional models and LLMs like ChatGPT and LLaMA, our approach achieves 15\% to 48\% performance gain in accuracy and F1 score.

items.detail: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running 21times faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running 10times faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being 31times faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. items.detail: We present SHARP, an approach to photorealistic view synthesis from a single image. Given a single photograph, SHARP regresses the parameters of a 3D Gaussian representation of the depicted scene. This is done in less than a second on a standard GPU via a single feedforward pass through a neural network. The 3D Gaussian representation produced by SHARP can then be rendered in real time, yielding high-resolution photorealistic images for nearby views. The representation is metric, with absolute scale, supporting metric camera movements. Experimental results demonstrate that SHARP delivers robust zero-shot generalization across datasets. It sets a new state of the art on multiple datasets, reducing LPIPS by 25-34% and DISTS by 21-43% versus the best prior model, while lowering the synthesis time by three orders of magnitude. Code and weights are provided at https://github.com/apple/ml-sharp
items.title_zh: 短小的锐利单视合成 比第二个
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍SHARP，一种从单一图像中进行光现实主义视图合成的方法。由于只有一张照片，SHARP将3D高斯代表所描绘的场景的参数倒置。这在标准GPU上用不到一秒时间通过单一的向导通过神经网络完成。然后，SHARP制作的3D Gaussian代表可以实时渲染，产生高分辨率的光现实化图像供附近观看。表示是度量的，绝对尺度，支持度量相机运动。实验结果显示，SHARP提供强力零射一般化的跨数据集。它在多个数据集上设定了一个新的技术状态，将LPIPS减少25-34%，DISTS减少21-43%，相对于最好的前期模型，同时将合成时间降低三个数量级。代码和权重见https://github.com/apple/ml-sharp。

items.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
items.subtitle: Language barriers in scientific documents hinder the diffusion and development of science and technologies. However, prior efforts in translating such documents largely overlooked the information in layouts. To bridge the gap, we introduce PDFMathTranslate, the world's first open-source software for translating scientific documents while preserving layouts. Leveraging the most recent advances in large language models and precise layout detection, we contribute to the community with key improvements in precision, flexibility, and efficiency. The work has been open-sourced at https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate with more than 222k downloads.

items.title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents

items.detail: Towards an embodied generalist for real-world interaction, Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) agents still suffer from challenging latency, sparse feedback, and irreversible mistakes. Video games offer an ideal testbed with rich visual observations and closed-loop interaction, demanding fine-grained perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, systematically evaluating these capabilities is currently hindered by heterogeneous action interfaces and heuristic verification. To this end, we introduce GameWorld, a benchmark designed for standardized and verifiable evaluation of MLLMs as generalist game agents in browser environments. Two game agent interfaces are studied: (i) computer-use agents that directly emit keyboard and mouse controls, and (ii) generalist multimodal agents that act in a semantic action space via deterministic Semantic Action Parsing. GameWorld contains 34 diverse games and 170 tasks, each paired with state-verifiable metrics for outcome-based evaluation. The results across 18 model-interface pairs suggest that even the best performing agent is far from achieving human capabilities on video games. Extensive experiments of repeated full-benchmark reruns demonstrate the robustness of the benchmark, while further studies on real-time interaction, context-memory sensitivity, and action validity expose more challenges ahead for game agents. Together, by offering a standardized, verifiable, and reproducible evaluation framework, GameWorld lays a robust foundation for advancing research on multimodal game agents and beyond. The project page is at https://gameworld-bench.github.io.
items.title_zh: GameWorld：走向标准化和可验证的多式游戏代理评价
items.detail_zh: 为了形成一个体现现实世界互动的通论者，多式联运大语言模型代理人仍然面临挑战性延迟、反馈稀少和不可逆转的错误。电子游戏提供理想的测试台，具有丰富的视觉观察和闭路互动，要求精细的感知，长视距规划，精确的控制。然而，由于各种行动界面和热力核查，目前无法系统地评估这些能力。为此，我们引入了GameWorld，这是为在浏览器环境中将MLLMs作为通用游戏代理进行标准化和可核查评价而设计的基准。研究了两种游戏代理界面： (一)直接发射键盘和鼠标控制的计算机使用代理， (二)通过定语语义动作解析在语义动作空间中发挥作用的通用式多式联运代理。 GameWorld包含34个多样的游戏和170个任务，每个任务都配有状态可验证的度量衡，用于基于结果的评价。横跨18个模型界面对子的结果表明，即使是最优秀的表演代理也远远没有在电子游戏上实现人的能力。重复的全方位基准重播的广泛实验表明基准的稳健性，同时对实时互动，上下文敏感性，动作有效性的进一步研究揭示了游戏代理商面临的更多挑战。 GameWorld通过提供一个标准化的，可核查的，可复制的评价框架，共同为推进对多式联运游戏代理商及以后的研究奠定了坚实的基础。项目网页见https://gameworld-bench.github.io。

items.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?

items.detail: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra是否实现了健全的情报工作？
items.detail_zh: GPT-6-Astra在机器人操纵和导航方面表现出一定的能力，对为个别任务和表现建立专门模式的传统模式提出了挑战。在本报告中，我们不仅询问GPT-6-Astra的能力如何，而且询问它的能力对该领域意味着什么。首先，我们探索独立的GPT-6-Astra的极限。我们对12项代表性基准进行大规模评估，这些基准涉及桌面操纵、人造物、移动平台和狡猾的手。根据统一协议，允许从培训设置的演示中学习内容，并大大增加执行步骤的数量，GPT-6-Astra取得了前所未有的成绩(图1)。未来的研究可能侧重于改善1)ICL(2)的成本和执行时间的普遍性，3)物理状态核查，4)从不可逆转的故障中恢复，5)长期保持进展。第二，我们研究 内含控制的力量。我们确认，一个高级"System 2"(即GPT-6-Astra)和低级"System 1"控制器(即"0.5")之间的近距离协调成本高而有效。第三，我们审查GPT-6-Astra的实际情况。我们关于8个机器人配置的实验揭示出巨大的差距：1)ICL所需的机器人演示费很昂贵的收集，2)在物理限制下以较长的执行时间换取更高的成功率是不可信的。第四，我们设想下一代包含的基准。我们开发了一个原型，即：(1) 任务来自现实世界的需要；(2) 不提供内部示范；(3) 法官在不断运转的世界时钟上进行审理。总而言之，我们的结果表明，GPT-6-Astra已基本跨越了已体现的能力界限，但尚未超越实际体现的智力界限。

items.detail: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU. A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps. Recent work has explored several approaches to this problem. What is essential is the multi-view agreement (Accord), which is considered in SLAM as a source of geometric self-consistency. Accord anchors each keyframe window to metric 3D points triangulated from the filter poses, then exploits bidirectional dense depth agreement between co-visible images to estimate and correct per-image scale errors while preserving the metric scale established by the anchors. Context keyframes further improve depth prediction, and the resulting submaps are fused in a factor graph. We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset. With nothing tuned per dataset/setup and every map aligned only by Accord's own trajectory, Accord achieves consistently best/second-best mean F-score at 5 cm on every platform. Accord is open-source along with the phone-rig dataset for the benefit of the research community
items.title_zh: 协议：从一台相机和一台IMU进行通用在线计量本地化和传感器绘图
items.detail_zh: 单相机和IMU的密集度度测量仍然具有挑战性：可视惯性偏振度测量(VIO)提供度量运动，但几何几何很少，而向导深度模型预测密度结构时并不确保度量尺度。我们提出《协议》，该协议从任何一台IMU的相机中绘制出准确的在线密集度测量图。一个VIO滤波器会发布度量表，一个以它们为条件的深度基础模型会预测出短键框窗口的深度，一个因子图会导出所生成的子图。最近的工作探讨了解决这一问题的若干办法。关键的是多景协议(Accord)，在SLAM中被认为是几何自相容的来源。将每个键框窗口锁定到从滤镜外形分解的公尺3D点上，然后利用可共见图像之间的双向密密深度协议来估计并纠正每幅图像尺度误差，同时保留被锚所设定的公尺尺度。背景键框会进一步改善深度预测，由此产生的子图会被一个因子图所熔接。我们评价了5个公共相机/IMU的单一绘图配置和一个新的Phone-rig/GOP数据集。由于每个数据集/设置没有调试，而且每张地图都只按协议本身的轨迹对齐，协议在每个平台上以5厘米的速度取得一致的最佳/第二最佳平均F分。协议是开放源码和电话设备数据集，受益者是研究界

items.detail: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
items.title_zh: Duo：双面互动的对等世界模式
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了对等世界模式(RWM)并介绍了Duo v1，这是一种完全复杂的世界模式，它持续地看待视听投入，同时实时回应用户。 RWM将智能和物理现实视为构成一个世界的同等基础。现有的世界模式主要侧重于模拟后者，将推理和决策作为外部控制，而不是世界本身的固有部分。在RWM中，我们确定了两个同样基本的能力：意向(提供认知基础的世界互动)和可实现(产生连贯的视听行为)。为了实现这一提法，Duo v1引入了三种关键技术设计： (1)为持续互动推理和参与决定而利用自递模型，而不是将其限制在对传播模型的理解上。 (2)构建块特异性条件，并按统一时间表，在意向与实现之间同步标语。模块特殊关注掩盖了块内和块间因果依赖性，阻碍了今后获得投入。 (3) 通过双重推出蒸馏法、关于自动生成的意向符号的培训以及从“实现”中综合的视听历史，减缓两个单元的分发转变。这两个模块不断看到实时的音频、视频和文本，从而能够与自发的交谈和中断进行全方位互动。除了对话之外，用户还可以分享真实对象，重塑虚拟场景，引导助手，或者在没有鼠标或键盘控制的情况下播放视听游戏。 Duo v1的发布使我们迈出了第一步，下一个版本即将到来。我们期待着更广泛地探讨这个正在出现的领域。

items.title: Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization

items.detail: Well-designed prompts are crucial for enhancing Large language models' (LLMs) reasoning capabilities while aligning their outputs with task requirements across diverse domains. However, manually designed prompts require expertise and iterative experimentation. While existing prompt optimization methods aim to automate this process, they rely heavily on external references such as ground truth or by humans, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where such data is unavailable or costly to obtain. To address this, we propose Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization (SPO), a cost-efficient framework that discovers effective prompts for both closed and open-ended tasks without requiring external reference. Motivated by the observations that prompt quality manifests directly in LLM outputs and LLMs can effectively assess adherence to task requirements, we derive evaluation and optimization signals purely from output comparisons. Specifically, SPO selects superior prompts through pairwise output comparisons evaluated by an LLM evaluator, followed by an LLM optimizer that aligns outputs with task requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPO outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods, achieving comparable or superior results with significantly lower costs (e.g., 1.1% to 5.6% of existing methods) and fewer samples (e.g., three samples). The code is available at https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.
items.title_zh: 自控快速优化
items.detail_zh: 精心设计的提示对于加强大型语言模型的推理能力至关重要，同时使其产出符合不同领域的任务要求。然而，人工设计的提示需要专门知识和反复试验。虽然现有的即时优化方法旨在使这一过程自动化，但它们严重依赖外部参考，如地面真相或人类的参考，限制了这些参考方法在缺乏数据或获取数据费用高昂的现实世界情景中的适用性。为了解决这一问题，我们提议自我监督的快速优化(SPO)，这是一个成本效益高的框架，在不需要外部参考的情况下，为封闭和开放的任务找出有效的诱因。我们的动机是，迅速的质量直接体现在LLM产出中，而LLM能够有效评估对任务要求的遵守情况，因此，我们纯粹从产出比较中获得评价和优化信号。具体来说，SPO通过由LLM评价员评价的对偶输出比较来选择上等提示，然后选择LLM优化器，使输出与任务要求保持一致。广泛的实验表明，SPO优于最先进的即时优化方法，取得可比或优异的结果，成本显著降低(如现有方法的1.1%至5.6%)，样本较少(如三个样本)。该代码可在https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT上查阅。

items.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
items.subtitle: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. items.detail: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
items.title_zh: AutoMaster：通过使同一模式成为更好的教师进行自主的后期培训
items.detail_zh: 单是任务成功并不能说明培训后应加强哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无根据的假设，非生产性重复，或表面的验证。我们提出Skill-FT(Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning)，使用自然语言技能压制不良习惯，并在教师推出时引起代表性不足的有效行为，然后对由此产生的轨迹目标模型进行微调。我们引入了AutoMaster系统，这是一个自主的培训后系统，一个LLM代理人通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及推出和目标模型评估的反馈来制定这些干预措施。 AutoMaster通过终端、搜索和软件工程任务以及4B和9B目标模型，在成功无制导的教师轨迹上比Vanilla SFT改进了平均性能，提高了1.42-8.99个百分点，教师、任务池、培训套装大小和SFT配方保持不变。这些结果与模拟和轨迹分析一起，表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师。我们进一步发现，在SFT期间保留技能指示比在所有6个场合取消这些指示产生更高的平均性能，尽管这些指示没有参加评价，而且监督产出相同。这些调查结果表明，作为培训示范的一部分，保持技能环境可以支持更好的行为内在化。

items.title: AtlasKV: Augmenting LLMs with Billion-Scale Knowledge Graphs in 20GB VRAM

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has shown some success in augmenting large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge. However, as a non-parametric knowledge integration paradigm for LLMs, RAG methods heavily rely on external retrieval modules and the retrieved textual context prior. Especially for very large scale knowledge augmentation, they would introduce substantial inference latency due to expensive searches and much longer relevant context. In this paper, we propose a parametric knowledge integration method, called AtlasKV, a scalable, effective, and general way to augment LLMs with billion-scale knowledge graphs (KGs) (e.g. 1B triples) using very little GPU memory cost (e.g. less than 20GB VRAM). In AtlasKV, we introduce KG2KV and HiKVP to integrate KG triples into LLMs at scale with sub-linear time and memory complexity. It maintains strong knowledge grounding and generalization performance using the LLMs' inherent attention mechanism, and requires no external retrievers, long context priors, or retraining when adapting to new knowledge.

items.detail: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.
items.detail_zh: 原生的3D生成主要围绕潜在扩散，最近的进展集中于更强的变异自编码器(VAE)，并日益细化从维塞特和triclanes到结构化的稀疏的Voxel的潜在表示。尽管它们的建筑差异，这些方法都有一个相同的前提：几何首先被压缩成一个潜伏的空间，然后才由生成器模拟。我们采用不同的路线，提出Direct3D-V3，一种潜在的无扩散变压器(DIT)框架，将VAE完全丢弃，在原生的Voxel域内运行，在培训和取样期间直接模拟原始的SDF voxel网格。为了让这种直接的 voxel 配方几何上可靠，我们引入了一种隐含的多重规范 相对于邻邻的 voxel 来抑制非水密表面，通过 Marching Cube 将预测的 SDF 网格转换成 meshes，这样正常的丢失可以直接从它的预测 SDF 来监督模型。为了改进调制图像与生成几何的对齐，Direct3D-V3还预测了调制图像的相机参数作为辅助任务，鼓励DiT学习从图像观测到3D形状的绘图。这种潜在的无潜质设计消除了重建瓶颈，将培训置于本土毒物领域的一个目标之下，并产生更丰富的本地细节。预测的相机和原生的SDF voxel输出进一步使Direct3D-V3扩展至基因重建，其扩散与正常的制导改进相交，以更好地与观测到的观点保持一致，而基因先前完成的未见区域。项目页：https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3。

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
items.title_zh: 最低业务安全标准-图像技术报告
items.detail_zh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以产生从简单的组成到信息密集的图形的不同视觉内容，然而开放式的文本到图像模型仍然与密集的文本和复杂的布局相抗衡。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了MOSS-Image，一种开放的生成系统，将高真性视觉合成与意向意识组成相结合。首先，我们用精心设计的食谱，从头开始预先训练5B型单流扩散变压器(DIT)，使双语长式文本渲染和精确布局控制成为可能。第二，我们开发了一个意向意识的即时增强(PE)模块，将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规格。它们共同使MOSS-Image生成内容丰富且布局一致的图像。我们进一步引入了LongLongText Bench(LLTB)来评价长式英文和中文文本渲染，以及RealLayoutArena(RLA)来评价端到端布局丰富的一代。 MOSS-Image在LLTB上的开放量级模型中实现了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率为96.3%。在RALA方面，MOSS-Image在端对端系统比较中排名第二，而其骨干在使用共享增强提示器评价的发电机中排名第一。我们将发布模式、培训食谱和评价框架，以支持进一步研究，并促进文本到图像社区。

items.detail: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
items.title_zh: SUPRA-TEX：带有超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
items.detail_zh: 单图像 3D 生成旨在将一个给定的 3D 网格以可燃材料着装，同时忠实地保存一个参考图像的视觉细节。现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入文物，要么通过隐含的图像特性条件来努力保存细微细节。为了应对这些挑战，我们采用了SUPRA-Tex，其基础是可视材料估算、表面对齐和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则。这种分工使得经过有限3D数据培训的3D生成器能够将其能力集中于保存可见证据和完成无法观察的表面。具体而言，我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型，在参考视图中预测照明分离的PBR地图。然后把这些地图投射到可见的表面 用预先训练过的材料 VAE编码器 编码成原生观测潜伏体 共享生成目标潜伏空间 间叶流变压器将这些潜伏物作为固定的、只读的锚，同时交替进行未观测区域和全表面更新，以产生完整的物质潜伏物。这个设计实现了与参考物的超调和，在可见区域上传递你所看到的是忠诚的事物，在看不见的表面上连贯完成。 SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训，在几何条件的纹理和端到端资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能，比对甚至超过了在闪烁的图像上领先的商业系统。项目网页：https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员：自我改进的 RLM 技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是相继的处理器，但长视机构需要外部信息并进行超出模型权重和活性上下文的计算。 Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器。持续的IPython REPL遵循了Recursive Language Model的抽象，用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算，而Continual Harness则保存了历史，记忆，技能，提示，和跨道的子剂规格。递归子剂通过直接代理对代理通信来协调，代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话。主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化，同时将战略构建留给模型。这种低温的显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障，并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力。 Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%，并在长文本编码、GPU-内核生成、模拟器构建和自主纳米GPT快跑中匹配或超过本地和受欢迎的牵引。在Instemio上，我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步，专用的子剂可以使工作并行。代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

items.detail: The rapid evolution of 3D content creation, encompassing both AI-powered methods and traditional workflows, is driving an unprecedented demand for automated rigging solutions that can keep pace with the increasing complexity and diversity of 3D models. We introduce UniRig, a novel, unified framework for automatic skeletal rigging that leverages the power of large autoregressive models and a bone-point cross-attention mechanism to generate both high-quality skeletons and skinning weights. Unlike previous methods that struggle with complex or non-standard topologies, UniRig accurately predicts topologically valid skeleton structures thanks to a new Skeleton Tree Tokenization method that efficiently encodes hierarchical relationships within the skeleton. To train and evaluate UniRig, we present Rig-XL, a new large-scale dataset of over 14,000 rigged 3D models spanning a wide range of categories. UniRig significantly outperforms state-of-the-art academic and commercial methods, achieving a 215% improvement in rigging accuracy and a 194% improvement in motion accuracy on challenging datasets. Our method works seamlessly across diverse object categories, from detailed anime characters to complex organic and inorganic structures, demonstrating its versatility and robustness. By automating the tedious and time-consuming rigging process, UniRig has the potential to speed up animation pipelines with unprecedented ease and efficiency. Project Page: https://zjp-shadow.github.io/works/UniRig/
items.detail_zh: 3D内容创作的迅速演变，包括AI动力方法和传统工作流程，正在推动前所未有的对自动操纵解决方案的需求，这些解决方案能够跟上3D模型日益复杂和多样化的步伐。我们引入了UniRig，一种新颖的，统一的自动骨骼操纵框架，它利用了大型自旋模型的能量，以及骨点交叉观察机制，生成高质量的骨架和剥皮重量。与以往与复杂或非标准地形进行斗争的方法不同，UniRig由于新的Skeleton Tree Tokenization方法有效地编码了骨架内的等级关系，准确地预测了地形上有效的骨架结构。为了训练和评价UniRig，我们提出了Rig-XL，这是一个新的大型数据集，由超过14 000个操纵的3D模型组成，涉及广泛的类别。 UniRig显著超越了最先进的学术和商业方法，使操纵精度提高215%，使挑战数据集的运动精度提高194%。我们的方法在各种物体类别之间无缝地工作，从详细的动因字符到复杂的有机和无机结构，显示了它的多面性和坚固性。 UniRig通过将繁琐耗时的操纵过程自动化，有可能以前所未有的便利和效率加速动画管道。项目网页：https://zjp-shadow.github.io/works/UniRig/

items.detail: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
items.title_zh: 纳米Muse：每个设备的开源个人代理
items.detail_zh: 2011年的助理回答并等待，2023年的特工做了一项任务并停下来。 2026年9月，Meta's Muse为一人展示了一名经纪人，其账户，设备，内存和对话持续，关闭，在一个卖家的云中，在一个国家。这样的代理人应该根据一个人的帐户和装置行事，在几周内记住这些帐户和装置，在值得的时候首先发言，并对它的所作所为负责。它是一种软件，不是模型，直到现在还没有开放的对应物。这份报告在五个问题和三个视野中定义了个人代理人。它读到Muse是如何从Meta的公开记录和它制作的即时副本中构建的，每个声明都有其来源的标记。然后呈现纳米Muse，GPL-3.0下的开源对应器，在一个人拥有的每个设备上都有一个代理，手机屏幕和计算机上都有手。他们通过一个接力分享一个对话 任何人都可以运行；每一个动作都通过一个哨兵，记忆是个人能够读到的文件，模型是他们的选择。其规模和费用作为估计数列出。开放的、有原产地的记忆、手的一套评价套件和手的开放式模型都作为路线图列出。

items.detail: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript
items.title_zh: 用于代理机器人操纵的世界语境学习
items.detail_zh: 训练有素的行动政策将操控技巧写入网络权重，将所学到的与所学到的分布挂钩。内语学习(ICL)避免了这种耦合，但并没有匹配训练有素的政策，因为另一场景中记录的演示没有从机器人目前面对的世界中获得任何反馈。我们观察到，一个代理人在上下文中学到的是语义学，记录任务步骤和对象角色而不是视觉外观，所以在一个世界中积累的经验转移到另一个世界。基于这种洞察力，我们提出"世界内文学习"(WICL)这个范例，一个被冷冻的模型从演示开始，在模拟器这样的世界里排练任务，把反馈写进它的背景而不是它的权重。我们建造了RoboScript，一个模块化的基础设施，用于执行WICL的代理操纵。从一次演示中，RoboScript通过模拟的排练来学习每个任务，将学到的知识冻结为任务记忆，并将冻结的内存部署在新场景上，数据隔离可以确保每个部署输入都可用在真正的机器人上。在RoboTwin 2.0的所有50项任务中，RoboScript达到83.4%，意味着在干净和随机的设置中取得成功，每个任务一次演示，没有梯度更新，超过训练最强的行动政策超过20分。这种方法概括了视觉分布，通过反射改进，与基础模型的尺度化，并通过交叉化的内存适应向物理双臂机器人转移。有了循环的世界，机器人就可以在上下文中学习操纵任务，也可以在重量上学习。所有代码均可在https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript查阅

items.detail: Few-step diffusion or flow-based generative models typically distill a velocity-predicting teacher into a student that predicts a shortcut towards denoised data. This format mismatch has led to complex distillation procedures that often suffer from a quality-diversity trade-off. To address this, we propose policy-based flow models (pi-Flow). pi-Flow modifies the output layer of a student flow model to predict a network-free policy at one timestep. The policy then produces dynamic flow velocities at future substeps with negligible overhead, enabling fast and accurate ODE integration on these substeps without extra network evaluations. To match the policy's ODE trajectory to the teacher's, we introduce a novel imitation distillation approach, which matches the policy's velocity to the teacher's along the policy's trajectory using a standard ell_2 flow matching loss. By simply mimicking the teacher's behavior, pi-Flow enables stable and scalable training and avoids the quality-diversity trade-off. On ImageNet 256^2, it attains a 1-NFE FID of 2.85, outperforming MeanFlow of the same DiT architecture. On FLUX.1-12B and Qwen-Image-20B at 4 NFEs, pi-Flow achieves substantially better diversity than state-of-the-art few-step methods, while maintaining teacher-level quality.
items.title_zh: Pi-Flow：通过仿真稀释法实现基于政策的几步生成
items.detail_zh: 很少步骤的传播或基于流的基因模型一般会将一个速度预测的老师蒸馏成一个预言向去声化数据的捷径的学生。这种格式上的不匹配导致了复杂的蒸馏程序，往往受到质量多样性权衡的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于政策的流动模式(pi-Flow)。 pi-Flow修改学生流模型的输出层，以预测一次无网络政策。然后，该政策在未来的分步骤产生动态流量速度，可忽略不计的间接费用，从而能够在不进行额外网络评价的情况下快速和准确地整合这些分步骤的ODE。为了将保单的ODE轨迹与老师的轨迹相匹配，我们引入了一种小说仿真蒸馏方法，这个方法将保单的速度与老师的轨迹相匹配，使用标准ell 2流量匹配损失。 Pi-Flow只是模仿教师的行为，就能够进行稳定和可扩展的培训，避免质量多样性的权衡。在ImageNet 256^2上，它获得了1.85的1-NFEFID，优于同一DiT架构的均价。在4 NFE的FLUX.1-12B和Quen-Image-20B上，pi-Flow在保持师资水平质量的同时，比最先进的几步方法，实现了大幅提高的多样性。

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.
items.title_zh: 多模块 GRPO：语言模型程序构建政策梯度和快速优化
items.detail_zh: 团体相对政策优化(GRPO)已被证明是培训后语言模型的有效工具。然而，AI系统越来越多地被表述为模块化程序，将多个LM调用组合在一起，并带有独特的即时模板和其他工具，目前尚不清楚如何最佳地利用GRPO来改进这些系统。我们开始通过定义mmGRPO来应对这一挑战，这是一个简单的GRPO的多模块概括，LM组通过模块逐个调用，处理可变长度和被中断的轨迹。我们发现由自动快速优化组成的 mmGRPO 提高了准确度 11% 跨分类，多跳搜索，和隐私保护任务 后训练的 LM，以及5% 的 自身快速优化。我们在DSPY开源的mmGRPO作为dspy。 GPRO优化器。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.detail: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.
items.title_zh: MACaQ：快速，模型不可知校准低精度重量和激活量
items.detail_zh: 重量激活量化可以降低神经网络推论的内存和计算成本，但最近的方法往往需要昂贵的优化和结构特有的跨层基础变换传播。我们采用MACaQ，一种MXFP4 W4A4训练后定量法，它独立处理每个线性层。 MACaQ采用每通道尺度，块-哈达玛德在线变换到每层的激活，同时吸收相应的反向变换到其重量。保留这些变换在线可以避免跨层的依赖性，并且能够实现简单流化的量化过程，其中一次只必须存有一层。为了改进轮到近的量化，我们引入了Flip-Refinement，一种黑森州协调-世系程序，它贪婪地将单个FP4代码移动到相邻的可代表值。尽管在推论时间执行激活变换，但MACaQ在vLLM中仅比纯MXFP4增加了2.3%的端对端管理费。 MACaQ达到比DuQuant++和MR-GPTQ更低的迷惑度，在11倍的减量化时间中已经匹配了它们在Llama-3-8B上的最佳迷惑度。我们进一步应用MACaQ而不对图像扩散模型进行特定架构修改，说明其层-局部设计的一般性，并在64分钟内显示122B参数模型的量化，只使用32.5GB GPU RAM。

items.detail: Flow-based generation in high-dimensional spaces is difficult because velocity prediction requires modeling high-dimensional noise, even when data has strong low-rank structure. We present Asymmetric Flow Modeling (AsymFlow), a rank-asymmetric velocity parameterization that restricts noise prediction to a low-rank subspace while keeping data prediction full-dimensional. From this asymmetric prediction, AsymFlow analytically recovers the full-dimensional velocity without changing the network architecture or training/sampling procedures. On ImageNet 256times256, AsymFlow achieves a leading 1.57 FID, outperforming prior DiT/JiT-like pixel diffusion models by a large margin. AsymFlow also provides the first-ever route for finetuning pretrained latent flow models into pixel-space models: aligning the low-rank pixel subspace to the latent space gives a seamless initialization that preserves the latent model's high-level semantics and structure, so finetuning mainly improves low-level mismatches rather than relearning pixel generation. We show that the pixel AsymFlow model finetuned from FLUX.2 klein 9B establishes a new state of the art for pixel-space text-to-image generation, beating its latent base on HPSv3, DPG-Bench, and GenEval while qualitatively showing substantially improved visual realism.
items.title_zh: 不对称流动模式
items.detail_zh: 基于流的生成在高维空间是困难的，因为速度预测需要建模高维噪声，即使数据有很强的低级结构。我们提出了非对称流模型(AsymFlow)，这是一种等级非对称速度参数化，将噪声预测限制在低级亚空间，同时保持数据预测全维。从这种不对称的预测中，AsymFlow在分析上恢复了全维速度而不改变网络架构或训练/取样程序。在ImageNet 256times256上，AsymFlow实现了领先的1.57 FID，以很大的比差比之前的DiT/JiT类像素扩散模型表现优异。 AsymFlow也提供了有史以来第一个将预先训练的潜流模型微调为像素-空间模型的路径：将低度恶作剧的像素子空间与潜伏的空间相配合，可以提供无缝的初始化，保存潜伏模型的高层次语义和结构，因此微调主要是改善低层次的错配，而不是重新学习像素生成。我们显示，从FLUX.2 Klein 9B中微调的像素AsymFlow模型为像素空间文本到图像生成建立了一种新的艺术状态，在HPSv3，DPG-Bench和GenEval上击败了它的潜伏基础，同时在质量上展现了大幅改进的视觉现实主义。

items.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
items.subtitle: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. items.detail: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
items.title_zh: Lynn Real-Hand：与手控解锁世界互动
items.detail_zh: 交互式视频世界模型通过文本和相机控制使探索成为可能，而直接对象交互则需要更精细的控制。手提供了自然界面，但将连续的手动转化为连贯的视觉反应仍然具有挑战性，因为手-对象动态复杂并需要实时计算。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了Lynn Real-Hand，这是一种手控视频世界模型，它统一了与高效流体生成的精确互动模型。我们控制了100K的相互作用片段，这些片段跨越不同的真实和合成环境，并发展手感监督，以改善精细的手动和物体相互作用。在此基础上，我们学习了几步生成的因果流图，并引入了区域-意识分数分馏法，结合了互补的视频和图像前作来完善互动动态和视觉外观。为了进一步减少推论延迟，我们提议使用Ultra-Fast-VAE，这是一个紧凑的视频解码器，它保持了高的重建忠诚度并大大降低计算成本。与现有方法相比，对Hand Bench进行的广泛评价显示，手跟手的准确性和视觉质量更高。我们的全序模型实现了181.67分的FVD和93.02分的MANO Dice分数，而三步因果模型保持了MANO Dice分数92.49分。对于实时互动，单H200上流的540p会达到18.03个FPS并有741ms的耐久性，最优化的峰值GPU记忆足迹只有34.89GB。我们将发布数据集，模型权重，以及完整的培训和推论代码，以支持手控视频世界模型的研究。

items.detail: Large language models have made research ideation increasingly accessible, yet effective idea development requires more than generating candidate directions. Researchers must ground a problem in current literature, identify meaningful bottlenecks, differentiate from existing solutions, and evaluate risks before committing to implementation. We present ResearchStudio-Idea as a reusable skill suite for this first mile of research ideation. The suite includes Paper-Search, a standalone multi-source literature search skill; Scoop-Check, a standalone prior-art collision checker for novelty claims; and IdeaSpark, the end-to-end skill that composes evidence grounding, pattern-guided generation, collision retrieval, audit, and idea-card rendering into one workflow. IdeaSpark is constructed from a corpus of 1,947 machine learning conference papers collected from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS between 2021 and 2025, including Oral papers, a separately tracked high-citation subset, and rejected submissions. Analysis of these outcomes reveals 31 recurring ideation sub-patterns, consolidated into 15 reusable ideation patterns. Each pattern is operationalized as a structured card containing research contexts, bottleneck types, differentiation strategies, supporting precedents, and common failure modes. Given a research problem and an evidence bundle, IdeaSpark evaluates evidence readiness, reconstructs the surrounding research context, identifies unresolved bottlenecks, selects relevant patterns, instantiates one candidate direction, retrieves potentially conflicting prior work, and performs outcome-informed auditing. This workflow transforms reusable ideation patterns into traceable research proposals. Blind automated-judge evaluations show that IdeaSpark consistently produces stronger research proposals than no-skill and generic-skill baselines while maintaining competitive novelty.
items.title_zh: 研究 -- -- 思想：由证据组成的研究 -- -- 技能设计套件，取自《多边法律公报》会议成果
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型使得研究思想越来越容易获得，然而有效的思想发展需要的不仅仅是产生候选方向。研究人员必须在目前的文献中找出问题，找出有意义的瓶颈，区别现有解决办法，并在承诺执行之前评估风险。我们提出"研究-思想"(ResearchStudio-Idea)，作为这个第一英里研究设想的可重复使用的技能套件。套件包括：独立多源文献搜索技能Paper-Search；Scoop-Check，为新颖性索赔的独立前作碰撞检查器；以及IdeaSpark，即将证据搁浅，图案制导生成，碰撞检索，审计，和想法卡渲染成一个工作流程的端到端技能。 IdeaSpark由2021年至2025年间从ICLR、ICML和NeurIPS收集的1,947份机器学习会议文件组成，其中包括口述论文、单独跟踪的高引号子集以及被拒绝的提交。对这些结果的分析揭示了31个反复出现的思想副标本，合并为15个可重复使用的思想模式。每种模式作为结构化的卡片运作，包含研究背景、瓶颈类型、区分战略、支持先例和常见故障模式。鉴于一个研究问题和证据捆绑，IdeaSpark评价证据准备情况，重建周围的研究背景，找出尚未解决的瓶颈，选择相关模式，即时分析一个候选方向，检索可能相互冲突的先前工作，并进行成果知情的审计。这种工作流程将可重复使用的思想模式转化为可追踪的研究建议。盲目自动裁判员评价显示，IdeaSpark在保持竞争性新颖性的同时，不断产生比无技能和通用技能基线更强大的研究建议。

items.detail: In pose estimation for seen objects, a prevalent pipeline involves using neural networks to predict dense 3D coordinates of the object surface on 2D images, which are then used to establish dense 2D-3D correspondences. However, current methods primarily focus on more efficient encoding techniques to improve the precision of predicted 3D coordinates on the object's front surface, overlooking the potential benefits of incorporating the back surface and interior of the object. To better utilize the full surface and interior of the object, this study predicts 3D coordinates of both the object's front and back surfaces and densely samples 3D coordinates between them. This process creates ultra-dense 2D-3D correspondences, effectively enhancing pose estimation accuracy based on the Perspective-n-Point (PnP) algorithm. Additionally, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Coordinate Encoding (HCCE) to provide a more accurate and efficient representation of front and back surface coordinates. Experimental results show that, compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods on the BOP website, the proposed approach outperforms across seven classic BOP core datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.
items.title_zh: HccePose( BF)：预测前方 QQ 后表面 用于构建 Pose 估计的 Ultra-ense 2D-3D 信件
items.detail_zh: 在对所见物体进行外观估计时，一个普遍的管道涉及利用神经网络预测2D影像上物体表面的密密的3D坐标，然后用来建立密密的2D-3D对应。然而，目前的方法主要侧重于更高效的编码技术，以提高预测的3D坐标在物体前表面的精度，俯瞰将物体的背面和内部融合起来的潜在好处。为了更好地利用天体的完整表面和内部，本研究预测了天体前表面和后表面的3D坐标以及它们之间的密集样本3D坐标。这个过程产生了超强的2D-3D对应，有效地增强了基于Purns-n-Point(PnP)算法的布局估计精度。此外，我们提议分级连续坐标编码(HCCE)，以便对前后表面坐标进行更准确和更有效的表述。实验结果表明，与BOP网站上现有的最先进的(SOTA)方法相比，拟议的方法在7个经典BOP核心数据集上都超过了绩效。代码见https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCEPose。

items.detail: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent.

items.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
items.subtitle: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.

items.detail: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling.
