items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且在优化期间优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据再加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的以数据为中心的统一动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域相混合调整，和样本再加权，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全相容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够被滴入替换，并统一了嵌入取取出，推论，梯度计算等关键依赖模型的操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行综合实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU的静态全数据培训上都一直超过业绩。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上以6B和30B符号标尺预先训练Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM既能提高MMLU的准确度，又能提高实体水平的复杂度，使其高于默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的一致运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems. Our analyses identify the design choices that matter most for generalization, including color encoding, prompt design, parameter adaptation, and task balancing. These choices interact, so individually helpful choices can hurt when combined with others. Starting from 4B and 9B parameter open-weight base models and using 2.1M-3.8M training pairs from public datasets, OVB surpasses Vision Banana's reported Cityscapes zero-shot performance (73.9 vs. 69.9 mIoU) and rivals state-of-the-art affine-invariant depth estimators. Its non-zero-shot variants come within five points of Vision Banana on referring and reasoning segmentation but remain further behind on instance segmentation. All models largely retain the base model's image-editing abilities. With legend ensembling, we introduce a test-time scaling method for generator-based perception. It segments an image under several class-color legends and fuses the results by majority vote, correcting unstable color-class bindings and improving mIoU by up to 8.7 points on Cityscapes and 15.0 points on COCO-Object without retraining. We release the dataset construction and processing pipeline, the training and evaluation code, as well as the final, intermediate, and ablation checkpoints. Project website: https://openvisionbanana.github.io
items.title_zh: Open Vision Banana：基因视觉感知的完全开放食谱
items.detail_zh: 最近的工作表明，预先训练的图像生成器编码现实世界的理解超越了图像合成。香蕉愿景通过将愿景任务设定为有条件的图像编辑来利用这一点。然而，其数据、权重、代码和执行细节并不公开。我们提出《香蕉开放愿景》(OVB)，这是将经过预先培训的发电机转换成统一的多任务感知系统的完全开放和可复制的食谱。我们的分析找出了对概括最重要的设计选择，包括颜色编码、即时设计、参数调整和任务平衡。这些选择相互影响，因此在与他人结合时，个别有益的选择会受到伤害。从4B和9B参数开放量基模型开始，使用公共数据集的2.1M-3.8M的训练配对，OVB超越了Vision Banana报道的Cityscapes零镜头性能(73.9 vs 69.9 mIoU)和最先进的affine-invariant深度估计器。其非零镜头变体在《香蕉愿景》的五个要点中涉及参考和推理分类，但在实例分类方面则更落后。所有模型基本上都保留了基础模型的图像编辑能力。通过传奇综艺，我们引入了基于生成器感知的测试时间缩放方法。它在几个类色传说下分割一个图像，并以多数投票的方式将结果熔化，纠正不稳定的色类绑定，并改进mIoU，在Cityscapes上达到8.7分，在COCO-Object上达到15.0分而不进行再培训。我们公布数据集的建造和处理管道、培训和评价守则以及最后、中间和废弃检查站。项目网站：https://openvisionbana.github.io

items.title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
items.subtitle: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. However, it is increasingly necessary to move KV caches outside GPU devices, to enable cache reuse across different queries and inference engines. items.detail: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. However, it is increasingly necessary to move KV caches outside GPU devices, to enable cache reuse across different queries and inference engines. Our real-world usage statistics confirm this trend: over time, the total KV cache stored by users has grown rapidly, far exceeding the capacity of GPU memory. Despite this need, there lacks an efficient solution for offloading and transferring KV caches. We present LMCACHE, the first and so far the most efficient open-source KV caching solution, which extracts and stores KV caches generated by modern LLM engines (vLLM and SGLang) out of the GPU memory and shares them across engines and queries. LMCACHE supports both cache offloading (prefix reuse across queries) and prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation (cross-engine/GPU cache transfer). LMCACHE's high performance and wide adoption stem from the following contributions: (1) highly optimized KV cache data movement powered by batched data movement operations, compute and I/O pipelining; (2) a modular KV cache connector component, decoupling LMCACHE from the rapid evolution of inference engines; (3) a first-class control API for flexible cache orchestration across GPU, CPU, storage, and network layers. Our evaluation shows that combining LMCACHE with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis. Large-scale adoption of LMCACHE in enterprise settings provides us valuable insights, for example, fetching KV cache from remote storage has unsurprisingly benefits to prefill delay, and that context truncation, which is a widely applied technique in industry, can greatly reduce prefix cache hit ratio by half. The source code of LMCACHE is at: https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache.
items.title_zh: LMCach：企业规模 LLM 的高效 KV 缓存层 推论
items.detail_zh: KV缓存传统上存储在GPU内存中，以加速大语言模型(LLM)推论的解码阶段。然而，越来越有必要将 KV 缓存移到 GPU 设备之外，以便缓存在不同的查询和推论引擎中重复使用。我们的现实世界使用统计证实了这一趋势：随着时间的推移，用户存储的KV缓存总量迅速增长，远远超过了GPU内存的能力。尽管有这种需要，但对于卸载和转移KV缓存缺乏有效的解决方案。我们提出LMCACHE，这是第一个也是迄今为止效率最高的开源KV缓存解决方案，它从GPU内存中提取并存储现代LLM引擎(vLLM和SGLang)生成的KV缓存，并在引擎和查询中共享。 LMCACHE既支持缓存卸载(前缀重复使用跨查询)，也支持预填解码(PD)分类(cross-engine/GPU缓存传输)。 LMCACHE的高性能和广泛的采用来源于以下贡献：(1)通过批量数据移动操作，计算和I/O管线来进行高度优化的KV缓存数据移动；(2)一个模块化的KV缓存连接器组件，将LMCACHE与推论引擎的快速演化脱钩；(3)一个用于跨GPU，CPU，存储，和网络层灵活缓存管的一流控制API。我们的评价表明，将LMCACHE与vLLM相结合，在多轮问题回答和文件分析等工作量方面，可实现15倍的吞吐量改善。在企业环境中大规模采用LMCACHE，为我们提供了宝贵的见解，例如，从远程存储中获取KV缓存对预填延迟毫无意外的好处，这种上下文截断是工业中广泛应用的一种技术，可以大大降低前缀缓存命中率的一半。 LMCACHE的源代码见：https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache。

items.detail: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.
items.title_zh: Duopra：从全双面对话到全双面机构
items.detail_zh: 完全复式互动模型显示出强大的对话机构，能够自然地、低纬度地进行转换、反通道和中断。然而，完成任务还需要任务机构：在用户更正后及时引用工具和修改论据。前端后端代理将启动与执行分开：前端决定是否以及要求什么，而后端决定如何。执行可以被卸载，但未经同意的请求不能执行，不完整的请求可以错误地引导后端。在Full-Duplex-Bench v3(FDB v3)上，我们流线管中Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness的大部分故障发生在域工具执行之前。我们引入了Duopra，一个全复式交互模型，学习任务执行与对话控制。 Duopra将后端视为工具，接受自成一体的自然语言请求。直接通话和后端授权共享一个行动界面，以及忠实启动和正确执行的要求。它的三阶段训练结合了协议SFT，全复式RL奖励及时和完整的执行，以及思想者更新后仅投影者修复谈话器的调制。使用相同的后端，Pass@1从4.7%升至44.7%；Duopra直接实现47.7%的调用工具(SFT后为26.0%)，49.3%的调用为DeepSeek后端。它提高了三个FDB v1.0收购率，超过了基准模型。这些结果显示任务机构可以与关键的对话机构共存。

items.detail: Looping is a powerful inductive bias for reasoning. By repeatedly iterating a recurrent block, looped models can scale their effective depth and enable multi-step reasoning in latent space. However, existing looped models are not inherently guided by an explicit measure of progress, making it difficult to determine when to stop looping and how to improve upon the current state. To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. The energy scores latent states, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a signal for stopping. To train EBRs effectively, we further introduce exploration-based training to discover additional modes and to better shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or outperform prior recurrent reasoning models, achieving 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345times less inference compute than the next-best model and maintaining comparable training compute. On all multi-solution benchmarks, EBRs achieve state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions while maintaining near-100% single-sample accuracy. These results suggest that energy-based models are a promising approach for strong reasoning performance.
items.title_zh: 以能源为基础的理性：你的经常性理性应该是以能源为基础的模型
items.detail_zh: 循环(Looping)是对推理的强烈的诱导偏差。循环模型通过反复重复的区块，可以扩展其有效深度，并在潜在空间中实现多步骤推理。然而，现有的循环模型本质上没有以明确的进度衡量为指导，因此难以确定何时停止循环以及如何改善目前的状况。为了实现这一点，我们引入了基于能源的理性(EBRs)，它学习了能量函数超过潜在推理状态，并制定了循环更新，作为这种能量的梯度下降。能量得分为潜伏状态，而其梯度则引导精细化，为停止提供信号。为了有效培训环境恢复方案，我们进一步引入基于勘探的培训，以发现更多模式，更好地在更广泛的国家形成能源景观。在整个四个算法推理基准中，EBRs匹配或超越了先前的反复推理模型，在数独-极限上达到99.9%的精度，同时使用345次的推论计算比次佳模型少，并保持可比的训练计算。在所有多解决方案基准上，EBR在保持近100%的单一样本准确性的同时，实现了独特有效解决方案的先进覆盖。这些结果表明，以能源为基础的模型是强有力的推理性能的有希望的方法。

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.detail: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that layer-paradigm matching can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.
items.title_zh: 保障人工智能代理：多层代理红色团队统一框架
items.detail_zh: 开源AI基础设施的快速发展，从模型服务引擎和代理平台，到模型背景协议(MCP)生态系统和语言模型本身，都超过了可用于防御它的安全工具。我们提出AI-Infra-Guard，这是一个开源框架，它组织AI红色团队围绕一个单一的观察：AI代理的攻击表面分层分层(基础设施，协议/工具，代理行为，以及模型)，没有一个单一的检测范式适合所有这些。因此，框架将一个范式与每一层相匹配，从确定规则比75+ AI组件和1{，}400+脆弱性规则，通过LLM驱动的代理审计MCP服务器和代理技能包以及多回合黑箱代理红色组合，到26+攻击操作员超过16个数据集的越狱控制带。据我们所知，这是涵盖所有这一切的唯一开放源码框架，包括对代理技能进行供应链审计，从而日益扩展AI代理。我们释放AI-Infra-Guard作为开放源代码，这样层-paradigm匹配就可以作为代理安全的实际基础和共享的基础，让社区在此基础上更进一步。

items.detail: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.
items.title_zh: 力量和谐：将力量转化为行动和物理学，用于冻结前沿模型
items.detail_zh: 边疆多模式模型现在可以控制从图像中零发的机器人，然而许多操纵任务依赖于图像无法显示的接触力。将武力带入只限API的冷冻模式，带来了两个挑战。首先，接触进化速度远快于API模型所能决定的速度，因此系统必须关闭模型下方的强制回路。第二，被冷冻的模型无法解释生力流，因此必须用模型能够解释的形式还原出力。因此，我们介绍ForceHarness，一种让被冻结的模型在不进行演示或微调的情况下使用武力的绳索。在单从腕感应器或联合扭矩来校正手力后，"ForceHarness"用自行调节力的自灭力原始来应对第一个挑战，并在接触活动中返回。为了应对第二个挑战，一个物理翻译层将每个力痕转化为物理量，并由此产生不确定因素。为了在同等条件下对照专家部队控制员和学习到的政策来评价"力量和谐"(ForceHarness)，我们还构建了"隐藏的Phys"(HidePhys)，这是一个有隐藏物理变量的七任务"MuJoCo"基准。在没有腕力传感器的真臂上，ForceHarness将GPT-6 Astra的零射入成功率从3.3%提高到90.0%。在模拟中，它在公共部队Bench套房中增加了17.5%，在HidePhys上增加了34.3个百分点，超过了在基准和HidePhys上匹配手写专家控制器的演示方面受过的对力量的认识政策。膨胀进一步表明，较小的模型在给定物理量而不是生力值时，能作出更好的决定。

items.title: MediaPipe: A Framework for Building Perception Pipelines
items.subtitle: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. items.detail: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. A developer needs to (a) select and develop corresponding machine learning algorithms and models, (b) build a series of prototypes and demos, (c) balance resource consumption against the quality of the solutions, and finally (d) identify and mitigate problematic cases. The MediaPipe framework addresses all of these challenges. A developer can use MediaPipe to build prototypes by combining existing perception components, to advance them to polished cross-platform applications and measure system performance and resource consumption on target platforms. We show that these features enable a developer to focus on the algorithm or model development and use MediaPipe as an environment for iteratively improving their application with results reproducible across different devices and platforms. MediaPipe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/google/mediapipe.
items.title_zh: MediaPipe：建设认知管道的框架
items.detail_zh: 建立能感知周围世界的应用是具有挑战性的。开发者需要(a) 选择和开发相应的机器学习算法和模型，(b) 建立一系列原型和演示，(c) 平衡资源消耗与解决方案质量，最后(d) 发现并缓解有问题的案例。 MediaPipe框架处理所有这些挑战。一个开发者可以使用MediaPipe通过将现有的感知组件组合起来来构建原型，以推进它们来抛光跨平台的应用程序并测量目标平台的系统性能和资源消耗。我们显示，这些特性使开发者能够专注于算法或模型开发，并使用MediaPipe作为环境来反复改进它们的应用，其结果可以在不同设备和平台上复制。 MediaPipe将在https://github.com/google/mediapipe上开源。

items.detail: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted to downstream tasks via reinforcement learning (RL) methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which often require thousands of rollouts to learn new tasks. We argue that the interpretable nature of language can often provide a much richer learning medium for LLMs, compared with policy gradients derived from sparse, scalar rewards. To test this, we introduce GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), a prompt optimizer that thoroughly incorporates natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error. Given any AI system containing one or more LLM prompts, GEPA samples system-level trajectories (e.g., reasoning, tool calls, and tool outputs) and reflects on them in natural language to diagnose problems, propose and test prompt updates, and combine complementary lessons from the Pareto frontier of its own attempts. As a result of GEPA's design, it can often turn even just a few rollouts into a large quality gain. Across four tasks, GEPA outperforms GRPO by 10% on average and by up to 20%, while using up to 35x fewer rollouts. GEPA also outperforms the leading prompt optimizer, MIPROv2, by over 10% across two LLMs, and demonstrates promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.
items.title_zh: GEPA：反思性快速演变能够超越强化学习

items.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration

items.detail: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable results across diverse downstream tasks, but their monolithic nature restricts scalability and efficiency in complex problem-solving. While recent research explores multi-agent collaboration among LLMs, most approaches rely on static organizational structures that struggle to adapt as task complexity and agent numbers grow, resulting in coordination overhead and inefficiencies. To this end, we propose a puppeteer-style paradigm for LLM-based multi-agent collaboration, where a centralized orchestrator ("puppeteer") dynamically directs agents ("puppets") in response to evolving task states. This orchestrator is trained via reinforcement learning to adaptively sequence and prioritize agents, enabling flexible and evolvable collective reasoning. Experiments on closed- and open-domain scenarios show that this method achieves superior performance with reduced computational costs. Analyses further reveal that the key improvements consistently stem from the emergence of more compact, cyclic reasoning structures under the orchestrator's evolution.
items.title_zh: 通过不断变化的管弦乐团进行多代理协作
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在各种下游任务中取得了显著成果，但其单一性限制了复杂问题的解决的可扩展性和效率。虽然最近的研究探索了有限责任管理小组之间的多代理协作，但大多数方法都依赖静态的组织结构，随着任务的复杂性和代理人数的增长，这些结构难以适应，导致协调间接费用和效率低下。为此，我们提出了基于LLM的多代理合作的傀儡式范式，中央管弦乐团("puppeteer")动态地指挥代理("puppetes")，以应对不断发展的任务状态。这个管弦乐团通过强化学习来进行训练，以适应性地排序和确定代理人的优先次序，从而能够进行灵活和可演变的集体推理。对封闭域和开放域情景的实验表明，这种方法通过降低计算成本实现了优异性能。分析还进一步揭示，关键改进始终源于管弦乐器演化下出现的更紧凑的循环推理结构。

items.detail: We present Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced large-scale 3D synthesis system for generating high-resolution textured 3D assets. This system includes two foundation components: a large-scale shape generation model -- Hunyuan3D-DiT, and a large-scale texture synthesis model -- Hunyuan3D-Paint. The shape generative model, built on a scalable flow-based diffusion transformer, aims to create geometry that properly aligns with a given condition image, laying a solid foundation for downstream applications. The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes. Furthermore, we build Hunyuan3D-Studio -- a versatile, user-friendly production platform that simplifies the re-creation process of 3D assets. It allows both professional and amateur users to manipulate or even animate their meshes efficiently. We systematically evaluate our models, showing that Hunyuan3D 2.0 outperforms previous state-of-the-art models, including the open-source models and closed-source models in geometry details, condition alignment, texture quality, and etc. Hunyuan3D 2.0 is publicly released in order to fill the gaps in the open-source 3D community for large-scale foundation generative models. The code and pre-trained weights of our models are available at: https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2
items.title_zh: Hunyuan3D 2.0：高分辨率文本化3D资产生成放大扩散模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍Hunyuan3D 2.0，这是一个高级的大型3D合成系统，用于生成高分辨率的文本化3D资产。这个系统包括两个基础组件：一个大规模形状生成模型-Hunyuan3D-DiT，和一个大规模纹理合成模型-Hunyuan3D-Paint。造型基因模型建立在可伸缩的流基扩散变速器上，旨在创造与特定条件图像适当对齐的几何学，为下游应用奠定了坚实的基础。纹理合成模型得益于强几何和传播前科，为生成的或手工制作的网盖制作高分辨率和充满活力的纹理图。此外，我们建造了Hunyuan3D-Studio -- -- 一个多功能、方便用户的生产平台，简化了3D资产的再创造过程。它使专业和业余用户能够有效地操纵甚至激活他们的网格。我们系统地评价我们的模型，显示Hunyuan3D 2.0比以前最先进的模型表现得更好，包括几何细节，条件对齐，纹理质量等方面的开源模型和闭源模型。 Hunyuan3D 2.0公开发布，以填补开源3D社区中用于大型基础基因模型的空白。我们的型号的代码和预先训练过的权重见https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2。

items.title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
items.subtitle: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). items.detail: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing. Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.
items.title_zh: 小米-OCR-0技术报告
items.detail_zh: 紧凑的OCR特有视觉语言模型实现了强大的文档解析性能，但往往依赖于昂贵的监督并主要专注于视觉文字重建。我们引入了Xiaomi-OCR-0，一个统一的0.8B模型，用于文档解析和OCR-中心理解。我们利用一个自动化数据引擎，将专家的共识、基于渲染的核查和有针对性的综合结合起来，建立一个大约170M-样本OCR中心体。从Qwen3.5-0.8B开始，我们的渐进式训练菜谱结合了以Q-mask为基础的文本主锚，持续预训，以及混合任务强化学习(Mix-RL)。小米-OCR-0在Real5-OmniDoc Bench上实现了95.24分，在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.83分，在Wild-OmniDoc Bench上实现了87.94分，同时在面向OCR的VQA5个基准上达到了83.2分的平均分。拨款情况进一步表明，经过充分的解析培训，以OCR为中心的理解监督为文件解析提供了额外的收益。主页：https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/小米-OCR-0。

items.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
items.subtitle: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. items.detail: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.

items.detail: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.
items.title_zh: 演进中的以下内容：代理- 辅助 LLM 规模服务
items.detail_zh: 代理工作量是LLM推断需求的主要来源。现有的预填解码(PD)分类服务系统为计算分配和KV缓存管理的运行时间调整提供了有限的灵活性，并依赖于粗糙的信号，这些信号只能部分地捕捉到多样的动态代理工作量。这些限制导致预填和解码节点与驱离KV缓存之间的负载不平衡，这些代理将重新使用。我们介绍Evolving Infra，这是一个代理适应服务框架，在运行时将计算分配适应代理工作量，KV缓存管理适应代理上下文管理。我们从密钥值(KV)缓存管理中解密分配，允许节点在预填和解码之间有效切换。基于这一设计，一个在线规划师将PD与工作量构成相匹配，而一位具有代理意识的KV管理器则以代理上下文管理的信号指导缓存驱逐和转移。通过GLM-5.2和Kimi K2.6在最多256 GB300 GPU上的编码、数学和计算机使用任务，Evolving Infra将平均端对端请求空闲度和P95 TTFT在Dynamo上减少4.1x和14x，NVIDIA的生产框架。

items.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
items.subtitle: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. items.detail: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.
items.detail_zh: 目前由音频驱动的视频传播模式可以合成现实的说话头视频，但一般需要数十个在多秒视频块上进行传播的去诺舞步，使其不适合语音助理和虚拟相机等流媒体应用，因为声音助理和虚拟相机需要低纬度和在线因果关系生成属性。 AURA 以滚动的 KV 缓存逐个生成视频块，只需要当前块的音频开始生成，而不是像双向模型那样的多秒音频外观。它有两种大小：AURA 1.3B流576p视频在单个GPU上实时播放(20.7 fps for a 16 Hz回放速率)，使其适合交互式的avatar应用程序；AURA 5B流720p视频在9.7 fps。我们的两相蒸馏管首先让因果学生与老师相配合，通过培训让老师的轨迹与传播步骤较少相匹配，并采用分块相滑的窗口因果注意口罩，然后应用放送相匹配分馏(DMD)与后向模拟来缩小所剩的质量差距。在标准谈话头基准上，AURA 1.3B运行速度快于自己的双向教师，并以更低的分辨率达到可与TalkVerse相比的质量，AURA 5B与其TalkVerse老师在720p同时运行更快。为了支持可再生性和对流相相相机生成的进一步研究，我们释放出两个模型的重量，同时释放出一个由30K合成视频组成的数据集，以及它们预算的教师轨迹。

items.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
items.subtitle: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
items.detail: This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.subtitle: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.detail: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers (1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).
items.subtitle_zh: 安全，快速，高效，战斗测试 在阿里巴巴的规模。混合结构代码审查工具：确定式管道+LLM 代理，精确的行级注释，内置多语言规则(NPE，线程安全，XSS，SQL注入)，OpenAI & Anthropic兼容。
items.detail_zh: Open Code Review是一个AI驱动的代码审查CLI工具。它起源于阿里巴巴集团的内部官方AI代码审查助理——在过去两年里，它为数以万计的开发者服务，并查明了数百万的代码缺陷。经过大规模的彻底验证后，我们把它孵化成一个面向社区的开源项目。简单的配置模式端点开始。它读作Git diffs，通过具有工具使用能力的代理将更改的文件发送到可配置的LLM，并以行级精度生成结构化的评论。代理可以读取完整的文件内容，搜索代码库，检查其他更改的文件以了解上下文，并产生深层评论——而不仅仅是表层diff反馈。除了diff审查之外， ocr扫描会审查整个文件，以审计不熟悉的代码库或目录，没有有意义的diff。由50个受欢迎的开源寄存器、200个真实的Pull请求和10种编程语言组成的现实世界代码审查基准——80+高级工程师交叉验证(1 505个附加说明的地面真相问题)。

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
items.subtitle: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
items.detail: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. Start a new app. The CLI scaffolds a frontend (CopilotKit on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick:
items.subtitle_zh: AG-UI：代理用户互动协议。让代理进入前端应用程序。
items.detail_zh: AG-UI是一个开放的，轻量级的，基于事件的协议，它规范了AI代理与用户界面应用程序的连接。特工们不符合请求/回应模式。它们流出代号，调用工具 中响应，更新共享状态，暂停一个人类，和产卵子剂，每个框架都不同。 AG-UI用一个双向事件流取代了自定义的线程：代理发送了输入的事件，任何客户端都可以渲染它们，不管哪个框架构建了代理。同名代理可以为网络应用，移动应用，终端，或Slack提供动力。启动新应用程序。 CLI脚手架前端(CopilotKit on Next.js，或终端客户端)连接到您选择的代理框架:

items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库

items.detail: Claude Code、Codex、CursorをはじめとするAIコーディング環境に読み込ませて使用してください。本体を入れられない環境のために、本体を短くした yomiyasu-mini と yomiyasu-pocket も公開しています（本体を入れられない環境では）。 文章を生成するAIは日常的な道具となりました。 一方で、AIで生成された文章には独特のクセが残りやすく、そのままでは実務や技術発信に使いにくい場面が多くあります。 1. 禁止語の置き換えにとどまる対処 「手触り」「解像度」「泥臭い」といった表層の単語を禁止しても、別の曖昧な語へ置き換わるだけで、不自然な文構造そのものは解消されませんでした。 2. 編集ルールの過剰適用 修辞の規範を与えすぎると、モデルが指示を過剰に解釈し、かえって不自然な造語や大げさな文体を招いていました。 3. 主述関係の曖昧さと非生物主語 誰が何をどうするのかが省略されたまま、概念や道具が比喩的な動詞（壊れる、倒す、効くなど）と結びつき、読み手が文脈を大きく補って読む必要がありました。 4. 形式の偏重と情報密度の低下 太字や箇条書きが増える一方で、手順やコードの仕組みといった核心の部分は抽象的に書かれ、文章の量に比べて実際の情報が少なくなっていました。

items.detail: OpenBUA was asked to "Find me 2 students from Australia using Linkedin and email them selling my app Petedoro" OpenBUA (Open Browser Use Agent) is an open-source, autonomous AI browser agent built as a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that runs directly inside your everyday browser. Unlike cloud browser-use tools that require spun-up headless containers, login bypass proxies, or remote servers, OpenBUA operates right inside your existing browser session with all your active cookies, credentials, and logins already available. Built with @earendil-works/pi-agent-core and @earendil-works/pi-ai, OpenBUA equips AI models with real-time DOM perception, intelligent multi-step navigation, synthetic event form-filling, incremental live research previews, and a self-learning memory system.

items.title: mojomast/open-higgsfield-skills
items.subtitle: Agent-agnostic skills that turn one prompt into a video with open-weights ComfyUI workflows (LTX, FLUX Klein, Qwen, Wan) - video-director orchestrator + 35 skills. #OpenSourceHiggsfield
items.author: Python
items.detail: One prompt in, a finished short video out, using only open-weights models on your own ComfyUI. open-higgsfield-skills is an agent-agnostic pack of 37 Agent Skills that teaches any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes, Pi or your own) to work as a film crew. The video-director skill takes a one-line idea such as "a lighthouse keeper finds a message in a bottle" and breaks it into a story bible, a shot list, keyframes, video shots, voice, music, captions and a final cut. It sends every step to ComfyUI workflows built on open weights: FLUX Klein, LTX-2.x, Qwen-Image-Edit, Wan, SeedVR2, ACE-Step, Chatterbox, Whisper and more. Every shot in the demo video was rendered by this pack from one manifest. video-director validated and packaged it, and google-colab-runner ran it as a single notebook on a Google Colab RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB, standard tier). All 14 jobs finished in about 8.5 compute units, including setup and the roughly 99 GB model download. The narration was also generated by the pack.

items.detail: Jazzband is the planned npm-native successor to the current Python Symphony workflow. Its job is to coordinate agents and tools around a public, inspectable delivery loop: Jazzband should work as a standalone CLI and as a library. It should coordinate tools without owning their private config, logs, or state. Today these commands return the initial orchestration contract shape. The next implementation increments will connect Linear, GitHub, Crosscheck, coding agents, and VerifyFlow.

items.title: DingyangLyu/MatOS
items.subtitle: MatOS: an agent operating system for materials research, with a layered scientific asset graph, stateful adaptive workflows and evidence-driven asset evolution.
items.author: TypeScript
items.detail: Describe a materials research task. MatOS assembles the scientific assets it needs, runs them as a stateful, checkable workflow, and turns every run into better assets for the next one. MatOS is an agent operating system for materials research. Materials studies run for days, cross literature, computation and experiment, and keep changing as results arrive. Agents for this work have to take on new data and software, keep long tasks on track, and remember what earlier tasks taught them. MatOS builds these capabilities around versioned scientific assets: data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles and workflows. Research tasks drive the stateful adaptive workflow, the layered scientific asset graph supplies composable capabilities, and execution traces and user feedback become reviewed asset revisions that return to the graph.
items.subtitle_zh: MatOS：用于材料研究的代理操作系统，具有分层的科学资产图，状态适应性工作流程和证据驱动的资产演化。
items.detail_zh: 描述一项材料研究任务。 MatOS将它所需要的科学资产组装起来，把它们运行为一个状态的，可核查的工作流程，并将每一次运行变为下一个更好的资产。 MatOS是一个用于材料研究的代理操作系统。材料研究持续数日，交叉文献，计算和实验，并随着结果的到来不断改变。这项工作的代理人必须掌握新的数据和软件，使长期任务走上正轨，并记住以前的任务教给他们什么。 MatOS围绕版本化的科学资产建立这些能力：数据，知识，工具，技能，角色和工作流程。研究任务驱动了状态适应性工作流程，分层的科学资产图提供了可混杂的能力，执行痕迹和用户反馈成为了经过审查的资产修订，回到图中。
